a: Yesh derusa lechatul o en derusa lechatul? amar leh: af lechuleda yesh derusa. yesh derusa lechuleda o en derusa lechuleda? amar leh: af lechatul en derusa.
Lechatul ulechuleda, yesh lahen derusa o en lahen derusa? amar leh: lechatul yesh derusa, lechuleda en derusa.
Vela kashya: ha daamar leh "af lechuleda yesh derusa" – beofot, ha daamar leh "af lechatul en derusa" – beimmere ravreve, ha daamar leh "lechatul yesh derusa, lechuleda en derusa" – bigdayim utelaim.
Bae rav ashe: shear ofot temein, yesh lahen derusa o en lahen derusa? amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe: ki havenan be rav kahana, amar: shear ofot temein yesh lahen derusa.
Vehaanan tenan: "uderusat hannetz beof haddak"! derusat hanetz bedichvavteh, veinach bidzutera minnayyhu. veikka deamri: derusat hannetz bidrabbi minneh, veinach bedichvavtayyhu.

Amar rav kahana mishshemeh derav shimi bar ashe: en derusa leshual. ini? veha ki ata rav dimi amar: maase vedaras shual rachel bammerchatz shel bet hine, uva maase lifne chachamim, veamru: yesh derusa! amar rav safra: hahi chatul hava.

Ikka deamri, amar rav kahana mishshemeh derav shimi bar ashe: yesh derusa leshual. ini? veha ki ata rav dimi amar: maase vedaras shual rachel bammerchatz shel bet hine, uva maase lifne chachamim, veamru: en derusa! amar rav safra: hahu kelev hava. amar rav yosef: naktinan en derusa lechelev.

Amar abbaye: naktinan, en derusa ella bayyad, leappoke regel dela. en derusa ella betzipporen, leappoke shen dela. en derusa ella middaat, leappoke shello middaat dela. en derusa ella mechayyim, leappoke leachar mita dela.
Amri: hasheta shello middaat amrat la, leachar mita mibbaya? la tzericha, dedares ufaskuha lideh. mahu detema: bahade dedares shade zihareh, ka mashma lan: bahade deshalef shade zihareh.

Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: ari shennichnas leven hashshevavrim, venimtza tzipporen begabbo shel echad mehen – en choshshin shemma ari deraso. may tama? rov arayot dorsin umiutan en dorsin, vechol haddores – en tzipporno nishmetet, vezot, hoil vetzipporen yoshevet lo begabbo – emar bakkotel nitchakkech.
Adderabba, rov shevavrim mitchakkechin, umiutan en mitchakkechin, vechol hammitchakkech – en tzipporen yoshevet lo begabbo, veze, hoil vetzipporen yoshevet lo begabbo, emar ari deraso!
Ikka lememar hachi, veikka lememar hachi – oke (milleta) [tora] achezkeh, have leh sefek derusa; verav letameh, deamar: en choshshin lisfek derusa.
Amar abbaye: la amaran ella tzipporen, aval mekom tzipporen – choshshin, vetzipporen name la amaran ella lacha, aval yevesha – avda demishtamta.
Velacha name la amaran, ella chada, aval tarte utelat – chayyshinan, vehu dekayyma bedara desichufeh.
Ittemar: rav amar: en choshshin lisfek derusa, ushemuel amar: choshshin lisfek derusa.

Dechulle alma, safek al, safek la al – ema la al. sefek kalba, sefek shunara – ema kalba. al, shetek veyatev benayyhu – emar shelama shavvi. keta resheh dechad minnayyhu – nach meritcheh. ihu ka meavvey veinhu kamkarkeran – baote ka mevaati
b: Ahadade. ki peligi deihu ka shatek veinhu kamkarkeran: mar savar maase ka aved behu, umar savar mechamat biatuteh hu deka avdan.
Amar ammemar: hilcheta choshshin lisfek derusa. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: hay derav may? amar leh: la shemia li, kelomar, la sevira li.

Vei baet ema: hadar beh rav legabbe dishmuel, dehahu sharkafa disfek derusot, daata lekammeh derav, shadderinhu lekammeh dishmuel, chankinhu ushedanhu benahara. vei salka datach la hadar beh – lishrinhu?
Ella may hadar beh? lesrinhu! ella, atreh dishmuel hava.
Lema li lemichnekinhu? lishdinhu hachi benahara! mefarchan vesalkan.
Uleshahinhu shenem asar chodesh? ate behu lide takkala. velizabbeninhu legoyim? atu lezabboninhu leyisrael.
Velichnekinhu velishdinhu leashpa? velitamaych, nishdinhu lichlavim! ella, lefarsome milleta deissura.

Hahu bar avavza dahava be rav ashe, al levene kenayya, nefak ata ki memasmas koeh dema. amar rav ashe: la amrinan sefek kalba sefek shunara – emar kalba? hacha name, sefek kanya sefek shunara – emar kanya machyeh.
Amri bene rabbi chiyyay: derusa sheamru – tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim.
Amar rav yosef: ha divne rabbi chiyyay – kevar persha shemuel, deamar shemuel mishshum rabbi chanina ben antignos: derusa sheamru – tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim.

Bae ilfa: yesh derusa lesimanim o en derusa lesimanim? amar rabbi zera: ha devae ilfa – kevar persha rav chanan bar rava, deamar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: derusa sheamru tzericha bedika keneged bet hechalal kullo, vaafillu besimanin.
Bae ilfa: simanin shenniddaldelu, bechamma? amar rabbi zera: ha devae ilfa – kevar persha rabba bar bar chana, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel: simanim shenniddaldelu berubban.

Bae rav amme: hamasmasa mahu? amar rabbi zera: ha devae rav amme – kevar persha rav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: bidrusa, ad sheyyaadim basar keneged bene meayim; nitmasmes habbasar – roin oto keillu eno.

Hechi dame nitmasmes? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: kol sheharofe gordo umaamido al basar chay. amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav kahana, ayyto kamman hahi rea, dechi havo motvi la – yatva shappir, vechi havo madlu la – hava talcha venafla tilche tilche, vetarefna la midderav huna bereh derav yehoshua.

Rav nachman amar: bekotz – ad shettinnakev lechalal, bidrusa – mishsheyyaadim basar keneged bene meayim. rav zevid matne hachi: bidrusa – mishsheyyaadim basar keneged bene meayim, besimanim – ad sheyyaadimu simanim atzmam.
Amar rav pappi, bae rav bivi bar abbaye:

a: Vevshet nekuvato bemashshehu, derusato bemashshehu. kane nekuvato bichissar, derusato bechamma? batar devaya hadar pashta: echad ze veechad ze bemashshehu. may tama? zihareh mikla kale veazel.
Yatev rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta kammeh derav nachman, veyatev vekaamar: derusa sheamru – tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim. rav nachman amar: haelohim! more ba rav mikkappa vead atma.
May kappa? illema kappa dida – hayeynu keneged bene meayim, ella mikkappa democha ad atma.

Ki selek rav chiyyay bar yosef, ashkechinhu lerabbi yochanan veresh lakish deyatvi vekaamri: derusa sheamru – tzericha bedika keneged bene meayim. amar lehu: haelohim! more ba rav mikkappa vead atma. amar leh resh lakish: mannu rav umannu rav? vela yadana leh!

Amar rabbi yochanan: vela nehira leh leoto talmid sheshshimmesh et rabbi rabba, verabbi chiyyay? vehaelohim! kol otan shanim sheshshimmesh oto talmid bishiva, ani shimmashti baamida, uman gevar? hu gevar becholla.
Miyyad patach resh lakish vaamar: beram zachur oto haish lattov, sheamru shemua mippiv: shemuta ushechuta – keshera, shei efshar lashshemuta shettease shechuta.
Verabbi yochanan omer: yavi veyakkif.
Amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella shello tafas besimanim, aval tafas besimanim veshachat – efshar lashshemuta shettease shechuta.
Ze hakkelal, leetoye may? leetoye shav shematata.
Deve yosef rishba machu begida nashya vekatli, ato lekammeh derabbi yehuda ben betera, amar lehu: vechi lehosif al hatterefot yesh? en lecha ella ma shemmanu chachamim!
Rav pappa bar abba rishba, machu bechuleya vekatli. ato lekammeh derabbi abba, amar lehu: vechi lehosif al hatterefot yesh? en lecha ella ma shemmanu chachamim!
Veha ka chazenan deka meta! gemiri dei badri la samma, chayyay.

Mishna veellu kesherot babbehema, nikkeva haggargeret o shennisdeka. ad kamma techsar? rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ad keissar haitalki. nifchata haggulegolet velo nikkav kerum shel moach, nikkav hallev velo levet chalalo, nishbera hashshidra velo nifsak hachut shellah, nittela hakkaved venishtayyer hemenna kezayit.

Hemses uvet hakkosot, shennikkevu ze letoch ze. nittal hattechol, nittelu hakkelayot, nittal lechi hattachton, nittela haem shellah, vacharuta bide shamayim. haggeluda – rabbi meir machshir, vachachamim poslin.
Gemara ittemar: rabbi yochanan amar: "ellu terefot" davka, verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: "ellu kesherot" davka.
Bemay ka mippalgi? bidrav matna, deamar rav matna: hay buka deatma deshaf midducheteh – terefa. rabbi yochanan amar: "ellu terefot" davka, tena terefot, utena "ze hakkelal",
b: Vechazyay lidrav matna deatya beze hakkelal, may tama? dedamya lintule. tena "ellu terefot" – hane hu ditrefa, ha derav matna keshera.

Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: ellu kesherot davka, tena terefot, utena "ze hakkelal", vechazyay lidrav matna dela atya beze hakkelal", may tama? lav linkuve damya, vela lifsuke damya, velintule name la damya, tena "ellu kesherot" – hane hu dichsherot, ha derav matna terefa.
Gufa, amar rav matna: hay buka deatma deshaf midducheteh – terefa, verava amar: keshera, vei ippesik niveh – terefa. vehilcheta: ippesik name keshera, ad demitachla itachole.
Ad kamma techsar? amar zeeri: attun dela mitchame lechon shiura, shiureh bedinara kuredinaa, vehave kifshita zutarti, umishtachcha bene peshite defumebdita.

Amar rabbi chana paturaa: illa minnay hava kae bar nappacha, uvea minnay dinara kuredinaa leshaore beh terefta, uveay lemekam mikkammeh vela shevakni. amar li: shev beni shev, en baale ummaniyyot rashshain laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheasukin bimlachtam.
Vela? vehatnan: kol baale ummaniyyot omdim mippenehem, veshoalin bishloman, veomrin lahem: achenu anshe mekom peloni boachem beshalom!

Amar rabbi yochanan: mippenehem omdin, mippene talmide chachamim en omdin. amar rabbi yose bar avin: bo uree kamma chaviva mitzva bishatah, shehare mippenehem omdin, mippene talmide chachamim en omdin.
Mimmay? dilma kede shello tehe nimtza machshilan leatid lavo.
Amar rav nachman: kesela – keyater mikkesela, keissar – keyater mikkeissar.
Alma kasavar rav nachman: "ad", velo ad bakkelal.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: chevel hayyotze min hammitta ad chamishsha tefachim – tahor. may lav chamishsha kilmatta? lo, chamishsha kilmala.
Ta shema: mechamishsha vead asara – tame. may lav asara kilmatta? la, asara kilmala.
Ta shema: haddakkin shebbichli cheres, hen vekarkerotehen vedofnotehem, yoshvin shello mesummachin –

a: Shiuran bichde sichat katan vead log. may lav log kilmatta? lo, log kilmala.
Ta shema: millog ad sea – birviit, may lav sea kilmatta? la, sea kilmala.
Ta shema: missea vead satayim – bachatzi log, may lav satayim kilmatta? la, satayim kilmala.
Vehatanya: log – kilmatta, sea – kilmatta, satayim – kilmatta.
Hatam lechumera, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kol shiure chachamim lehachemir, chutz mikkigris shel ketamim lehakel.
Dayka name, dekatane ala dehahi: chamishsha – kilmala, asara – kilmatta.
Nittal hattechol, amar rav avvira mishshemeh derava: lo shanu ella nittal, aval nikkav – terefa.
Metiv rabbi yose bar avin, veittema rabbi yose bar zevida: chotech meubbar shebbemeeha – muttar baachila, min hattechol umin hakkelayot – asur baachila. ha behema gufa sharya!
Hu haddin daafillu behema name asira, ayyeyde ditna resha "muttar baachila", tena name sefa "asur baachila". veibbaet ema: nikkav lechod, venechtach lechud.
Nittelu hakkelayot. amar rachish bar pappa mishshemeh derav: lakta bechuleya achat – terefa. amri bemareva: vehu dimtay lakuta
b: Limkom charitz. vehecha mekom charitz? lechivvara detute motne. amar rav nechuneya: sheeltinhu lechullehu tarofae demareva, veamri li hilcheta kerachish bar pappa, velet hilcheta kerav avvira.
Derav avvira name la amaran, ella bekulesheh, aval besumecheh – terefa, vei ishteyayr beh keovi dinar zahav – keshera.
Amri bemareva: kol happosel barea – kasher bakkuleya, shehare nekev pasul barea, vechasher bakkuleya, vechol shekken hecha dechasher barea – kasher bakkuleya.

Matkef la rabbi tanchuma: uchelala hu? hare mugela, dechasher barea ufasul bakkuleya! vahare mayim zakkin, dichsherim hacha vehacha, ella amar rav ashe: terefot ka medammet lahadade? en omrim bitrefot zo doma lazo, shehare chotchah mikkan vameta, chotchah mikkan vechayta.
Umayim zakkin kesherim, la amaran ella detzilli, aval achiri – terefa. vechi tzilli name la amaran ella dela seriach, aval seriach – terefa.
Hakkuleya shehiktina, baddakka – ad kefol, baggassa – ad kaanava benonit.
Nittal lechi hattachton, amar rabbi zera: lo shanu ella sheyyechola lichyot al yede leita vehameraa, aval enah yechola lichyot al yede leita vehameraa – terefa.
Nittela haem shellah, tana: hi haem, hi tarpachat, vehi shalpuchit.
Vacharuta bide shamayim – keshera. tanu rabbanan: ezohi charuta? kol shetztzamka rea shellah. bide shamayim – keshera, bide adam – terefa. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af bide kol habberiyyot.
Ibbaya lehu: rabbi shimon ben elazar aresha kae ulekulla, o assefa kae ulechumera?
Ta shema, detanya: charuta bide adam – terefa, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af bide kol habberiyyot.

Rabba bar bar chana hava kaazel bemadbera, ashkach hanhu dichre ditzmik rea didhu. ata sheel be midresha, amaru leh: bekayyta – ayyti meshichle chivvare, umallinhu mayya karire, veannechinhu meet leet. i hadran baryayn – bide shamayim hi ucheshera, vei la – terefa. besitva – ayyti meshichle shichume, umallinhu mayya pashore, veannechinhu meet leet. i hadra barya – keshera, vei la – terefa.

Haggeluda: tanu rabbanan: haggeluda – rabbi meir machshir vachachamim poslim, uchevar heid elazar safra veyochanan ben gudegda al haggeluda sheppesula. amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: chazar bo rabbi meir.

Mikkelal dilrabbi shimon ben elazar pelig rabbi meir bigluda? vehatanya: amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku rabbi meir vachachamim al haggeluda sheppesula, uchevar heid rabbi oshaya beno shel rabbi yehuda habbassam lifne rabbi akiva mishshum rabbi tarfon al haggeluda sheppesula, veim nishtayyer bo kesela – keshera. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may "lo nechleku"? lo amad rabbi meir bemachalokto.
Amar mar: im nishtayyer bo kesela – keshera. hecha? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: al pene hashshidra kullah.

Ibbaya lehu: daarich vekattin, dechi metzaref la have kesela, o dilma berochav sela al pene hashshidra kullah? ta shema, defaresh rabbi nehoray mishshemeh dishmuel: berochav kesela al pene kol hashshidra kullah.
Rabba bar bar chana amar: rashe ferakim. rabbi elazar ben antignos mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi yannay amar: mekom tibburo.
Bae rabbi yannay berabbi yishmael: nittal mekom hashshidra vechullo kayyaym, nittal mekom tibburo vechullo kayyaym, nittelu rashe ferakim vechullo kayyaym, may? teku.
Amar rav: kol haor kullo matztzil bigluda, chutz meor bet happerasot, verabbi yochanan amar: afillu or bet happerasot name matztzil.

Bea minneh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan: or bet happerasot mahu sheyyatztzil bigluda? amar leh: matztzil. amar leh, limmadtanu rabbenu: ellu sheorotehen kivsaran – or bet happerasot! amar leh: al takniteni, shebbilshon yachid ani shone otah.
Detanya: hashshochet et haola lehaketir kezayit meor shel tachat haalya chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet; chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.

Eliezer ben yehuda ish evlayim amar mishshum rabbi yaakov, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish [kefar] ikkus omer mishshum rabbi shimon: echad or bet happerasot, veechad or harosh shel egel harach, veechad or shel tachat haalya, vechol shemmanu chachamim gabbe tumea ellu sheorotehen kivsaran,

a: Lehavi or bet habboshet chutz limkomo pasul veen bo karet, chutz lizmanno piggul vechayyayvim alav karet.

Mishna veellu terefot baof: nekuvat havvevshet, ufesukat haggargeret, hikketa chuleda al roshah makom sheose otah terefa, nikkav hakkurekvan, nikkevu haddakkin, nafla laur venechmeru bene meeha, im yerukkim – pesulim, im adummim – kesherim. derasah uterafah bakkotel o sheritztzetzatta behema umefarkeset, veshahata meet leet ushechatah – keshera.
Gemara rav ushemuel velevi deamri: machnis yado lifnim uvodek, im mevatzbetz veole – terefa, veim lav – keshera.

Hanicha leman deamar ad deminnekiv kerama tattaa, ella leman deamar innekiv illaa af al gav dela innekiv tattaa, nechush dilma illaa innekiv tattaa la innekiv? i ita deinnekiv illaa, tattaa aggav rukkecheh mifka paka.
Amar zeeri: en bedika lechuleda, mippene sheshshinneha dakkot. vechi shinneha dakkot may have? amar rav oshaya: mippene sheshshinneha dakkot vaakummot.

Ki selek linhardea, shelach lehu: devarim sheamarti lifnechem taut hen beyadi, beram kach amru mishshemeh derabbi shimon ben lakish: bodkin lechuleda bayyad, aval lo bemasmer, verabbi yochanan amar: af bemasmer.

Uviflugeta derabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya, chad badek bida, vechad badek bemachta. man devadek bida amar leh leman devadek bemachta: ad matay atta mechalle mamonan shel yisrael? amar leh man devadek bemachta leman devadek bida: ad matay atta maachil leyisrael nevelot?
Nevelot? veha shechuta hi! ella terefot, shemma nikkav kerum shel moach.

Tistayyem derabbi yehuda hu devadek bida, detanya: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi yehuda: bodkin lechuleda bayyad, aval lo bemasmer. nishbar haetzem, af al pi shello nikkav kerum shel moach – tistayyem.

Ha gufa kashya, amrat: bodkin lechuleda bayyad aval lo bemasmer. alma it leh bedikuta, vahadar tane: nishbar haetzem af al pi shello nikkav kerum shel moach. alma let leh bedikuta! sefa atan leof shel mayim, hoil veen lo kerum. en lo kerum salka datach? ella, hoil ukerumo rach.

Amar leh rav nachman lerav anan: mar amar shemuel badek bida umachshar, vehuna chavrin amar rav badek bida umachshar. vehatane levi: terefot shemmanu chachamim bivhema – kenegdan baof, yater alehen of – nishbar haetzem af al pi shello nikkav kerum shel moach? amar leh: hahu beof shel mayim, hoil veen lo kerum. en lo kerum salka datach? ella, hoil ukerumo rach.

Hahi tarnegolta dahavay be rav chana, shaddera lekammeh derav matna. nishbar haetzem velo nikkav kerum shel moach havay, veachshera. amar leh: vehatane levi: terefot shemmanu chachamim bivhema kenegdan baof, yater alehen of – nishbar haetzem af al pi shello nikkav kerum shel moach! amar leh: hatam beof shel mayim, hoil veen lo kerum. en lo kerum salka datach? ella ema: hoil ukerumo rach.
Rav shezvi badek beshimsha, rav yemar badek bemayya, rav acha bar yaakov badek
b: Begila dechitteta.
Amar rav shezvi: hane avavze didan keof shel mayim damyayn.
Nafla laur, amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben yehoshua: shiur yerukkatan keshiur nekuvatan, ma nekuvatan bemashshehu – af yerukkatan bemashshehu.

Bea minneh rav yosef bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi merabbi yehoshua ben levi: horika kaved keneged bene meayim mahu? amar leh: terefa. velo yehe ella nittela! amar rava: kevan shehorika kaved keneged bene meayim – beyadua shennafla laur, venechmeru bene meayim, uterefa.

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi haveya leh hahi tarnegolta, shaddereh lekammeh derabbi elazar hakkappar beribbi, amar leh: yerukkin havo, veachshera. vehaanan tenan: "yerukkin pesulin"! lo amru "yerukkin pesulin" ella bakkurekvan, ballev uvakkaved. tanya name hachi: beellu bene meayim amru – bakkurekvan, ballev uvakkaved.

Rabbi yitzchak bar yosef hava leh hahiv tarnegolta, shaddera lekammeh derabbi avahu, vaamar leh: adummin havo uterefa. vehaanan tenan: "adummin kesherim"! amar leh: adummin shehoriku virukkin sheheedimu – terefa, lo amru "adummin kesherim" ella ballev bakkurekvan uvakkaved.

Amar rav shemuel bar chiyyay amar rabbi mani: adummin shehoriku ushelakan vechazru veheedimu – kesherin, may tama? kutera ayel behu. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anu nomar, adummin shello horiku ushelakan vehoriku – terefa, may tama? iggallay bahtayyhu. amar rav ashe: hilkach la lechol inash ella beshilka. vela hi, achzoke reuta la machzekinan.
Derasah uterafah bakkotel. amar rabbi elazar ben antignos mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi yannay: achat zo veachat zo tzericha bedika.

Mishna veellu kesherot baof: nikkeva haggargeret, o shennisdeka, hikketa chuleda al roshah makom sheeno ose otah terefa, nikkav hazzefek, rabbi omer: afillu nittal, yatzu bene meeha velo nikkevu, nishtabberu gappeha, nishtabberu ragleha, nimretu kenafeha, rabbi yehuda omer: im nittela hannotza pesula.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi simay verabbi tzadok shehalchu leabber shana belod, veshavtu beono, vehoru betarpachat kerabbi bezefek.
Ibbaya lehu: horu betarpachat leissura, kerabbi bezefek lehettera? o dilma: horu betarpachat lehettera kerabbi bezefek, aval kerabbi bezefek la sevira lehu? teku.
Amar rabba, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: gaggo shel zefek niddon kevevshet. hecha? amar rav bivi bar abbaye: kol shennimtach immo.

Yatzu bene meeha, amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: lo shanu ella shello hippech bahen, aval hippech bahen – terefa, dichtiv: "hu ascha vaychonnecha", melammed shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu konaniyyot baadam, sheim nehpach (achat) [echad] mehen – eno yachol lichyot.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: "hu ascha vaychonnecha" – karcha decholla beh, mimmennu kohanav, mimmennu neviav, mimmennu sarav, mimmennu melachav, shenneemar: "mimmennu finna mimmennu yated vegomer".
Hahu romaa dechazyeh lehahu gavra dinfal meiggara leara, pekaoy kereseh unefuk mayayneh, atyeh livreh veshachteh kammeh

a: Baachuzzat enayim, innegid veittenach, ul (lameayyneyh) [mayayneh] vechayyeyteh lichreseh.
Nishtabberu ragleha. hahu tzanna deinkore daatay lekammeh derava, badkeh rava betzomet haggidin, veachshereh.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: shemutat yad babbehema – keshera, shemutat yarech babbehema – terefa, shemutat yarech baof – terefa, shemutat gaf baof – terefa, chayyshinan shemma nikkeva harea. ushemuel amar: tibbadek, vechen amar rabbi yochanan: tibbadek.

Chizkiyya amar: en rea laof, verabbi yochanan amar: yesh lo veyeshnah keale shel vevred ben agappayim. may "en rea laof"? illema delet leh kelal – veha ka chazenan deit leh! ella dela mitterif beh, vehatane levi: terefot shemmanu chachamim babbehema – kenegdan baof, yater alehen of nishbar haetzem af al pi shello nikkav kerum shel moach!
Ella, en lo lo linnafel velo lechamer. may tama? amar rav chana: hoil verov tzaloteha meginnot aleha.

Veha middeamar rabbi yochanan: yesh lo, veyeshnah keale shel vevred ben agappayim – mikkelal dechizkiyya savar delet leh! ella amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina: middevarav shel beribbi nikkar sheeno baki betarnegolin.

Amar rav huna amar rav: shemutat yarech baof keshera. amar leh rabba bar rav huna lerav huna: veha rabbanan daato mippumebdita amaru rav yehuda mishshemeh derav amar: shemutat yarech baof terefa! amar leh: beri, nahara nahara ufeshateh.

Azal rabbi abba, ashkecheh lerav yirmeya bar abba deka badek betzomet haggidin. amar leh: lema leh lemar kulle hay? veha rav huna amar rav: shemutat yarech baof keshera! amar leh: ana matnitin yadana: behema shennechtechu ragleha min haarkubba ulematta keshera, min haarkubba ulemala pesula, vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin, veamar rav ala: vechen baof.

I hachi, kashya derav adderav! ishtik. amar leh: dilma shane leh ben shemuta lachatucha? amar leh: veat mefarshat shematateh derav? beferush amar rav: shemuta – keshera, chatucha – pesula. veal titma, shehare chotchah mikkan vameta, chotchah mikkan vechayta.
Ki selek rabbi abba, ashkecheh lerabbi zera deyatev vekaamar: amar rav huna amar rav: shemutat yarech baof terefa. amar leh: chayye demar, miyyoma dislek mar lehacha
b: Hava lan pitchon pe kammeh derav huna usheelneh, vaamar lan: shemutat yarech baof keshera.

Veashkachteh name lerabbi yirmeya bar abba deyatev veka vadek betzomet haggidin, veakshi leh: la savar la mar ha deamar rav huna amar rav: shemutat yarech baof keshera? amar li: ana matnitin yadana: behema shennechtechu ragleha, min haarkubba ulemitta – keshera, min haarkubba ulemala – pesula, vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin, veamar rav ala: vechen baof.

Vaamari leh: i hachi, kashya derav adderav! ishtik, veakshay leh: vedilma shane leh lerav ben shemuta lachatucha? veamar li: veat mefarshat shemateh derav? beferush amar rav: shemuta – keshera, chatucha – pesula.
Veat, ma bidach? hachi amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: shemutat yarech baof terefa, vechen amar rabbi yaakov bar idi amar rabbi yochanan: shemutat yarech baof terefa.

Veamar rabbi yaakov bar idi: ilmale hava rabbi yochanan beatra deoro ba chavravavta lehettera, la parkes. deamar rabbi chanina amar rabbi: shemutat yarech baof keshera. vetarnegolet hayta lo lerabbi chanina shennishmeta yarech shellah, veheviah lifne rabbi vehittirah lo, umelachah rabbi chanina, vahava more ba halacha lattalmidim: ze hittir li rabbi, ze hittir li rabbi.

Velet hilcheta kechol hane shematata, ella ki ha dishel rabbi yose ben nehoray et rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kedirat kane bechamma? amar lo: mishna shelema shaninu, ad keissar haitalki. amar lo: vahalo rachel achat hayta bishchunatenu shennikdar kane shellah, veasu lah kerumin shel kane vechayta!

Amar lo: veal da at samech? vahalo halacha rovachat beyisrael: shemutat yarech baof terefa, vetarnegolet hayta lo lerabbi shimon ben chalafta shennishmeta yarech shellah, veasu lah shefoferet shel kane vechayta! ella may it lach lememar: toch shenem asar chodesh hava, hacha name toch shenem asar chodesh hava.

Amru alav al rabbi shimon ben chalafta sheaskan bidvarim haya, vehaya ose davar lehotzi millibbo shel rabbi yehuda, shehaya rabbi yehuda omer: im nittela hannotza pesula. vetarnegolet hayta lo lerabbi shimon ben chalafta shennittela notza shellah, vehinnicha battannur, vetala aleha bematlit shel tarsiyyim, vegiddela kenafayim haacharonim yoter min harishonim.
Vedilma kasavar rabbi yehuda terefa mashbachat? im ken, bemidde demittarfa ba – higdila kenafayim haacharonim yoter min harishonim?!

May askan bidvarim? amar rav mesharsheya, dichtiv: "lech el nemala atzel ree deracheha vachacham, asher en lah katzin shoter umoshel, tachin bakkayitz lachmah". amar: ezil ichze i vadday hu delet lehu malka!

Azal bitkufat tammuz, parseh liglimeh akkinna deshumeshmane. nefak ata chad minnayyhu, atnach beh simana. al, amar lehu: "nefal tulla". nefaku vaato, dalyeh liglimeh, nefal shimsha. nefalu aleh vekatleh. amar: shema minna let lehu malka, dei it lehu haremana demalka la livo.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: vedilma malka hava bahadayyhu? i name, haremana demalka havo nekiti? i name ben malka lemalka hava, dichtiv: "bayyamim hahem en melech beyisrael ish hayyashar beenav yaase"? ella, semoch ahemanuta dishlomo.

Amar rav huna: siman litrefa – shenem asar chodesh. metivi: siman litrefa – kol sheenah yoledet. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mashbachat veholechet – beyadua shehi keshera, mitnavvevna veholechet – beyadua shehi terefa. rabbi omer: siman litrefa – sheloshim yom. amru lo: vahalo harebe mitkayyeymot shetayim shalosh shanim!

Tannae hi, detanya: uvaggulgolet, ad sheyyesh bah nekev echad aroch, afillu nekavim harebe mitztarfim limlo makdeach. amar rabbi yose ben hameshullam: maase beinbul, beechad shennifchata gulgolto, veasu lo chidduk shel keruya vechaya. amar lo rabbi shimon ben elazar: mishsham reaya? yemot hachamma haya, vechevan sheavru alav yemot hatztzinna miyyad met.
Amar rav acha bar yaakov, halacha: terefa yoledet umashbachat. amar ammemar: hane bee ditrefa

a: Shichla kamma asira, mikkan veelach – have leh ze vaze gorem, umuttar.
Etiveh rav ashe leammemar: veshavin bevetzat terefa sheasura, mippene sheggadla beissur! hatam bidsafna meara.
Velishanne leh beshichla kamma? im ken, "gadla"? "gamra" mibbee leh.

Ella, ha ditnan: velad terefa, rabbi eliezer omer: lo yikrav legabbe mizbeach, verabbi yehoshua omer: yikrav. bemay ka mippalgi? beshennitrefa ulevassof ibbera, rabbi eliezer savar: ze vaze gorem asur, verabbi yehoshua savar: ze vaze gorem muttar. i hachi, addemippalgi legavoah, lippalgu lehedyot?
Lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehoshua, daafillu legavoah name share.
Velippalgu lehedyot, lehodiacha kocho derabbi eliezer, daafillu lehedyot name asavr! koach dehettera adif leh.
Umodim bevetzat terefa sheasura, bidsafna meara, dechad gorem hu.
Rav acha savar la kerav acha bar yaakov, umatne la lidammemar kedaamaran.
Ravina la savar la kidrav acha bar yaakov, umatne la lidammemar behay lishshana: amar ammemar: hane bee disfek terefa, deshichla kamma meshahenan lehu, i hadra vetaana – sharyayn, vei la – asiran.
Etiveh rav ashe leammemar: umodim bevetzat terefa sheasura, mippene sheggadla beissur. amar leh: hatam bidshichla kamma. im ken, "gadla"? "gamra" mibbee leh! teni: gamra.

Ella, ha ditnan: velad terefa, Rabbi eliezer omer: lo yikrav legabbe mizbeach, Rabbi yehoshua omer: yikrav, bemay ka mippalgi? kesheibbera ulevassof nitrefa, rabbi eliezer savar: ubbar yerech immo hu, verabbi yehoshua savar: ubbar lav yerech immo hu. i hachi, addemippalgi legavoah, lippalgu lehedyot!
Lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehoshua. velippalgu behedyot lehodiacha kocho derabbi eliezer? koach dehettera adif leh.
Umodim vadday bevetzat terefa sheasura, bidshichla kamma, may tama? gufa hi.
Vehilcheta bezachar – kol shenem asar chodesh, binkeva – kol sheenah yoledet.
Amar rav huna: kol (beriyya) sheen bo etzem eno mitkayyem shenem asar chodesh. amar rav pappa: shema minna midderav huna, ha deamar shemuel: kishshut (shehitlia) [shehitlia] beibbeha asura.
b: Hane tamre dechadda levatar teresar yarche shatta sharyayn.
Amar rav: let baka bar yoma, velet didva bat shatta.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, veha amri inashe: shav shene immeray bakta mibbaka. deamra leh: chaziteh levar machoza discha bemayya, uselek veikkerech bisdinin, veittevt aleh umetzet minneh, vela hodat li. amar leh: velitamaych, ha deamri inashe "shittin mane parzela telu leh levaka bekurenaseh", mi ikka? ihu gufeh kamma have? ella bemane didhu, hacha name bishne didhu.

Tenan hatam: behema baalat chamesh raglayim, o sheen lah ella shalosh – hare ze mum. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella shechaser veyater bayyad, aval chaser veyater baregel – terefa name havya. may tama? kol yater kenatul dame.
Hahi chevta dahava la tarte sanya deve, ayytuha leravina, vetarfa midderav huna. vei shafchan lahadade – keshera.
Hahi guveta dahava nafka mibbe chase lehuvelila, savar rav ashe lemitrefa. amar leh rav huna mar bar chiyyay lerav ashe: kol hane cheve barayayta hachi it lehu.

Hahu guveta dahava meabbera mibbe chase lichresa, sevar mar bar rav ashe leachshora. amar leh rav oshaya: attu kullehu bachada mechita machetinhu? hecha deittemar – ittemar, hecha dela ittemar – la ittemar.

Heid natan bar shela rav tabbachayya detzippori lifne rabbi, al shene bene meayim hayyotzin min habbehema keechad, shehi terefa, uchenegdan baof – keshera. bamme devarim amurim? sheyyotzin bishne mekomot, aval yotzin bemakom echad, vechalin ad keetzba – keshera.
Peligi ba rav amme verav assi, chad amar: hu dehadri vearvi, vechad amar: af al gav dela hadri vearvi.
Bishlama leman deamar hu dehadri vearvi, hayeynu dekatane "ad keetzba", ella leman deamar af al gav dela hadri vearvi, may "ad keetzba"? ad keetzba millematta.

Rabbi yehuda omer: im nittela hannotza – pesula. amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yehuda verabbi yishmael amru davar echad. rabbi yehuda – ha daamaran, rabbi yishmael – ditnan: rabbi yishmael omer: hannotza mitztarefet.

Amar rava: dilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hacha ella leinyan terefa, delekka midde demaggen aleh, aval leinyan ippaggole – kerabbanan sevira leh, vead kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael hatam ella leinyan ippaggole, aval leinyan terefa – aggone la maggen.

Mishna achuzat haddam, vehameushshenet, vehametzunnenet, vesheachla haredufene, vesheachla tzoat tarnegolim, o sheshshatat mayim haraim – keshera. achla sam hammavet, o shehikkishah nachash – mutteret mishshum terefa, vaasura mishshum sakkanat nefashot.
Gemara amar shemuel: hilitah chiltit – terefa, may tama? dimynakkeva lehu lemayayna.

Metiv rav shezvi: achuzat haddam, vehameushshenet, vesheachla haredufene, vesheachla tzoat tarnegolim, veshatat mayim haraim, hilitah tia, chiltit ufilpelin, achla sam hammavet – keshera. hikkishah nachash, o shenneshachah kelev shote – mutteret mishshum terefa, vaasura mishshum sakkanat nefashot. kashya chiltit achiltit, kashya sam hammavet assam hammavet!
Chiltit achiltit la kashya: kan bealin, kan bikratin. sam hammavet assam hammavet la kashya: ha dida, ha deadam. sam hammavet divhema hayeynu haredufene? tere gavvne sam hammavet.
May tia? amar rav yehuda:

a: Ikkara demarirta.

Amar rav yehuda: hay man daachal telata tikle chiltit allibba rekana – mishtelach mashcheh. amar rabbi avahu: bedidi hava ovada, vaachali chad tikla chiltita, vei la ditavi bemayya – mishtelach mashchay, vekiyyaymti beatzmi "hachochma techayye vealeha".
Amar rav yosef: hay man deachel shittasre bee, vearbee amgoze, veshav buteyata defirche, veshate revieta deduvesha bitkufat tammuz, allibba rekana – mitakar talya delibbeh.

Hahu bar tavya daata leve resh galuta, dahava (mefassek) [mefassekan] karin batrayayta, badkeh rav betzomet haggidin veachshereh. sevar lemechal minneh beumetza, amar leh shemuel: la chayesh mar lenikkure?
Amar leh: may takkanta? notveh betannura deihu badek nafsheh. otveh, nefal tilche tilche. kare shemuel aleh derav: "lo yeunne latztzaddik kol aven". kare rav aleh dishmuel: "kol raz la anes lach".

Mishna simane behema vechayya neemru min hattora, vesimane haof lo neemru, aval amru chachamim: kol of haddores – tame, kol sheyyesh lo etzba yetera vezefek vekurekvano niklaf – tahor. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: kol of hacholek et raglav – tame.

Uvachagavim, kol sheyyesh lo arba raglayim, vearba kenafayim, vekartzullayim, uchenafav chofin et rubbo. rabbi yose omer: ushemo chagav. uvaddagim, kol sheyyesh lo senappir vekashkeshet. rabbi yehuda omer: shene kaskassin usenappir echad. veellu hen kaskassin – hakkevuin bo, usenappirim – happoreach bahen.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: ellu hen simane behema – "kol behema mafreset parsa vegomer", kol behema shemmaalat gera – beyadua sheen lah shinnayim lemala, utehora.
Uchelala hu? vahare gamal, demaale gera hu, veen lo shinnayim lemala, vetame! gamal nive it leh.

Vahare ben gamal, denive name let leh, vetu, hare shafan vearnevet demaalat gera hen veyesh lahen shinnayim lemala, utemein! veod, shinnayim mi ketivi beorayyta? ella hachi kaamar: kol behema sheen lah shinnayim lemala – beyadua shehi maalat gera umafreset parsa, utehora.

Velivdok befarsoteha! kegon shehayu parsoteha chatuchot, vechidrav chisda, deamar rav chisda: haya mehallech bammidbar umatza behema shepparsoteha chatuchot – bodek befiha, im en lah shinnayim lemala – beyadua shehi tehora, im lav – beyadua shehi temea, uvilvad sheyyakkir gamal. gamal nive it leh! ella, uvilvad sheyyakkir ben gamal.

Lav amrat ikka ben gamal? ikka name mina acharina dedame leven gamal! la salka datach, detane deve rabbi yishmael: "veet haggamal ki maale gera hu", shallit beolamo yodea sheen lecha davar maale gera vetame ella gamal, lefichach parat bo hakkatuv "hu".
Veamar rav chisda: haya mehallech badderech umatza behema sheppiha gamum, bodek befarsoteha: im parsoteha sedukot – beyadua shehi tehora, im lav – beyadua shehi temea, uvilvad sheyyakkir chazir.

Lav amrat ikka chazir? ikka name mina acharina dedamya lachazir! la salka datach, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "veet hachazir ki mafris parsa hu" – shallit beolamo yodea sheen lecha davar shemmafris parsa vetame ella chazir, lefichach parat bo hakkatuv "hu".

Veamar rav chisda: haya mehallech bammidbar, umatza behema sheppiha gamum ufarsoteha chatuchot – bodek bivsarah, im mehallech sheti vaerev – beyadua shehi tehora, veim lav – beyadua shehi temea, uvilvad sheyyakkir arvad.
Lav amrat ikka arvad? ikka name mina acharina dedame learvad! gemiri delekka. vehecha bodek? amar abbaye, veittema rav chisda: bechanfe haoketz.
Simane chayya. tanu rabbanan: ellu hen simane chayya. chayya bichlal behema hi lesimanin! amar rabbi zera:
b: Lehattir chelbah, vehachi kaamar: ellu hen simane chayya shechelbah muttar – kol sheyyesh lah karnayim utelafayim.
Rabbi dosa omer: yesh lah karnayim – i atta tzarich lachazor al telafayim, yesh lah telafayim – tzarich atta lachazor al karnayim, vekeresh, af al pi sheen lo ella keren achat – muttar.
Kelala hu? vahare ez, deyesh lo karnayim utelafayim, vechelbo asur! keruchot baenan. vahare shor, dichruchot, vechelbo asur! charukot baenan.
Vahare ez, dacharukot, vechelbo asur? mefutztzalot baenan! vahare tzevi, deen mefutztzalot, vechelbo muttar? chadurot baenan.
Hilkach, hecha demippatzla – la dina vela dayyayna; hecha dela mippatzla – baenan keruchot, chadurot, vacharukot, vehu demibbela chirkayyhu.

Vehayeynu sefeka deizza karkuz. hahi izza karkuz dahavay be resh galuta, daakur mela tzanna detarba minna. rav achay asar, rav shemuel bereh derabbi avahu achal minneh, kare annafsheh: "mipperi fi ish tisba bitno".
Shelachu mittam: hilcheta kevavteh dishmuel bereh derabbi avahu, vehizzaharu berabbenu achay, shemmeir ene gola hu.

Vekeresh, af al pi sheen lo ella keren achat, muttar. amar rav yehuda: keresh tavya deve illay, tigris arya deve illay. amar rav kahana: tesha ammehata have ben unna leunna dearya deve illay. amar rav yosef: shittesar ammehata have mashcheh detavya deve illay.

Amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: elohechem kearya metil, dichtiv "arye shaag mi lo yira", may revuteh? parasha katel arya! amar leh: lav kehay arya metil, kearya deve illay metil. amar leh: baena demaychazet leh nihali. amar leh: la matzet chazet leh. amar leh: ivra, chazena leh! bea rachame, itakar midducheteh,

Ki hava merachayk arba mea parse, nayhem chad kala, appilu kol meabberata, veshura deromi nefal. addimrachak telat mea parse, nayhem kala acharina, netur kakke veshinne degavre, veaf hu nefal mikkuresyay leara. amar leh: bematuta minnach, bee rachame aleh delehdar leducheteh. bea rachame aleh, veahdar leh leatreh.
Amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: baena deichze lelahaychu. amar leh: la matzet chazet leh. amar leh: ivra

a: Chazena leh. azal okmeh lahade yoma bitkufat tammuz, amar leh: istakkal beh. amar leh: la matzena. amar leh: yoma, dechad mishshammashe dekayymi kamme dekudesha berich hu amrat la matzena leistakkala beh, shechina lo kol shekken.

Amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: baena deitzbet leh nahama lelahaychu. amar leh: la matzet. ammay? nefishi chelvavteh. amar leh: ivra. amar leh: pok tzevet leguyda dirvita, dirviach alma. terach shitta yarche kayyta, ata zika kansheh leyamma.
Terach shitta yarche desitva, ata mitra tabbeeh beyamma. amar leh: may hay? amar leh: hane kanoshae zalochae deatu kammeh. amar leh: i hachi la matzena.

Amara leh bat kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: elahechon naggara hu, dichtiv "hamekare vammayim aliyyotav". ema leh denebed li chada masturita. amar: lechayye, bea rachame ala veinnaga. otva beshuka deromi veyahavi la masturita, dahavo nehigi dechol dimnagga beromi yahavu leh masturita, veyatev beshuka vesatar dulele, ki hechi delichzo inashe velive rachame aleh.

Yoma chad hava ka chalef hatam, havat yatva vesatra dulele beshuka deromae, amar la: shappirta masturita dihav lich elahay. amara leh: ema leh lelahaych lishkol may dihav li. amar lah: elaha didan mehav yahev, mishkal la shakel.
Amar rav yehuda: shor kerastan ufarsetan, rav resheh verav genuveteh, vechillufa bachamara. lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar.
Veamar rav yehuda: shor shehikriv adam harishon, keren achat hayta lo bemitzcho, shenneemar: "vetitav laAdonai mishshor par makrin mafris" – makrin tarte mashma! amar rav nachman: "makran" ketiv.
Veamar rav yehuda: shor shehikriv adam harishon, karnav kodmot lefarsotav, shenneemar: "vetitav laAdonai mishshor par makrin mafris" – makrin beresha, vahadar mafris.

Mesayyay leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol maase vereshit bekomatan nivreu, bedatan nivreu, betzivyonam nivreu, shenneemar "vaychullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam", al tikre "tzevaam" ella "tzivyonam".

Daresh rabbi chanina bar pappa: "yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav", pasuk ze sar haolam amaro, beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu "leminehu" bailanot, nasu deshaim kal vachomer beatzman:

Im retzono shel hakkadosh baruch hu beirbuveya, lamma amar "leminehu" bailanot? veod kal vachomer: uma ilanot sheen darkan latzet beirbuveya, amar hakkadosh baruch hu "leminehu" – anu al achat kamma vechamma!
Miyyad kol echad veechad yatza lemino, patach sar haolam veamar: "yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav".
Bae ravina: hirkiv shene deshaim ze al gav ze
b: Lerabbi chanina bar pappa mahu? kevan dela ketav behu "leminehu" la michayyayv, o dilma kevan dehiskim ayyedayhu – keman dichtiv behu "leminehu" damya? teku.

Rabbi shimon ben pazzi rame: ketiv "vayyaas elohim et shene hammeorot haggedolim", uchetiv "et hammaor haggadol veet hammaor hakkaton". amra yareach lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, efshar lishne melachim sheyyishtammeshu becheter echad? amar lah: lechi umaati et atzmech.

Amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, hoil veamarti lefanecha davar hagun, amit et atzmi?! amar lah: lechi umeshol bayyom uvallayla. amara leh: may revuteh? dishraga betihara may ahani? amar la: zil limno bach yisrael yamim veshanim. amra leh: yoma name i efshar dela manu beh tekufata, dichtiv "vehayu leotot ulemoadim uleyamim veshanim". zil likro tzaddike bishmich: "yaakov hakkatan", "shemuel hakkatan", "david hakkatan".

Chazyay dela ka miyyatteva data, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: haviu kappara alay shemmiatti et hayyareach! vehayeynu deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: ma nishtanna sair shel rosh chodesh shenneemar bo "laAdonai"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: sair ze yehe kappara al shemmiatti et hayyareach.

Rav assi rame, ketiv: "vattotze haaretz deshe" (bitlat) [bitlata] beshabba, uchetiv: "vechol siach hassade terem yihye vaaretz" bemaale shabbeta, melammed sheyyatzu deshaim veamdu al petach karka, ad shebba adam harishon uvikkesh alehem rachamim, veyardu geshamim vetzamchu, lelammedcha shehakkadosh baruch hu mitavve litfillatan shel tzaddikim.
Rav nachman bar pappa haveya leh hahi ginneta, shedi bay bizrane vela tzemach. bea rachame, ata mitra utzemach. amar: hayeynu derav assi.

Amar rav chanan bar rava: "hashshesua" beriyya bifne atzmah hi, sheyyesh lah shene gabbin ushene shidraot. vechi moshe rabbenu kenigi haya o ballistari haya? mikkan teshuva laomer en tora min hashshamayim.
Amar leh rav chisda lerav tachlifa bar avina: zil ketov "kenigi uvallistari" beaggadtaych, ufarsha.

"Veet chameshet sarne felishtim haazzati vehaashdodi haeshkeloni haggitti vehaekroni vehaavvim", amar chamsha vechashev shitta! amar rabbi yonatan: aruneke shellahen chamishsha. amar leh rav chisda lerav tachlifa bar avina: ketov "aruneke" beaggadtaych ufarsha. ufeliga derav, deamar rav: avvim mitteman bau.

Tanya name hachi: avvim mitteman bau, velamma nikra sheman avvim? sheivvetu et mekoman. davar acher: avvim, sheiuu leelohot harebe. davar acher: avvim, shekkol haroe otam ochazto avit. amar rav yosef: veit lehu shittasre dare shinne lechol chad vechad.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: harebe mikraot sheruyin lisrof kesifre minin, vehen hen gufe tora. "vehaavvim hayyoshvim bachatzerim ad azza" – may nafka lan minna?
Middeashbeeh avimelech leavraham "im tishkor li ulenini ulenechdi", amar hakkadosh baruch hu: leto kaftorim lippeku meavvim, dehayynu pelishtim, veleto yisrael lippeku mikkaftorim.

Keyotze baddavar atta omer: "ki cheshbon ir sichon melech haemori hiv vehu nilcham bemelech moav vegomer". may nafka minna? daamar lehu hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: "al tatzar et moav". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lete sichon lippok mimmoav, veleto yisrael velippeku missichon. vehayeynu deamar rav pappa: ammon umoav tiharu besichon.

"Tzidonim yikreu lechermon siryon", tana: senir vesiryon mehare eretz yisrael, melammed shekkol echad veechad meumot haolam halach uvana lo kerach gadol leatzmo, veheela lo al shem hare eretz yisrael, lelammedcha sheafillu hare eretz yisrael chavivin al umot haolam.
Kayyotze bo: "veet haam heevir oto learim", may nafka minna? dela likro leechav galvavta.
Simane haof lo neemru, vela? vehatanya: "nesher",

a: Ma nesher meyuchad sheen lo etzba yetera vezefek veen kurekvano niklaf vedores veochel – tame, af kol kayyotze bo – tame. torin sheyyesh lahen etzba yetera vezefek vekurekvan niklaf veen dorsin veochlin – tehorin, af kol kayyotze bahen – tehorin. amar abbaye: lo neemar perushan middivre tora ella middivre sofrim.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: of habba besiman echad tahor, lefi sheen dome lenesher. nesher delet leh kelal – hu dela techol, ha ikka deit leh chad – techol.
Velelaf mittorin: ma torin deikka kullehu arbea, af hacha name ad deikka kullehu arbea?
Im ken, shear ofot temein dichtav rachamana lema li?
Venelaf minnayyhu: ma hatam telata vela achlinan, af kol telata vela nechol, vechol shekken tere vechad?
Im ken, orev, dichtav rachamana, lema li? hasheta deit leh telata la achlinan, deit leh tere mibbaya?
b: Velelaf meorev: ma hatam tere la, af kol tere la? im ken, peres veozniyya dichtav rachamana lema li? hasheta deit leh tere la achlinan, deit leh chad mibbaya!

Venigmar mipperes veozniyya? im ken, nesher dichtav rachamana lema li? hasheta deit leh chad la achlinan, delet leh kelal mibbaya! ella nesher delet leh kelal – hu dela techol, ha deit leh chad – echol.
Veella, tama dichtav rachamana nesher, ha lav hachi hava amena: lelaf mipperes veozniyya? have leh peres veozniyya shene chetuvin habbain keechad, ushene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.
Gemiri, deikka behay lekka behay, udeikka behay lekka behay.
Mikkede esrim vearbaa ofot temeim havu, i efshar dechad deikka behanach lekka behane, vehavu lehu shene ketuvim habbaim keechad.

Gemiri: esrim vearbaa ofot temeim havu, vearbaa simanin. telata hadri bechullehu, esrim mehem shelosha shelosha, utere beorev, chad beferes vechad beozniyya, deiteh beha leteh beha. mahu detema lelayf minneh – ketav rachamana "nesher", nesher delet leh kelal hu dela techol, ha ikka deit leh chad – echol.
Ella, torin dichtav rachamana lema li? amar rav ukeva bar chama: lekorban. amar rav nachman:

a: Haya baki bahen uvishmotehen – of habba besiman echad tahor, lo haya baki bahen uvishmotehen – besiman echad tame, bishne simanin tahor, vehu sheyyakkir orev.

Orev vetu la? vehatanya: "orev" – ze orev, "lemino" – rabbi eliezer omer: lehavi et hazzarzir. amru lo lerabbi eliezer: vahalo anshe kefar temarta shebbihuda hayu ochlim otan mippene sheyyesh lahen zefek! amar lahem: af hen atidin litten et haddin.

Davar acher: "leminehu" lehavi senunit levana, divre rabbi eliezer. amru lo: vahalo anshe galil haelyon ochlim oto, mippene shekkurkevano niklaf! amar lahem: af hen atidin litten et haddin. ella orev vechol min orev.

Amar ammemar: hilcheta, of habba besiman echad – tahor, vehu dela dares. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: ha derav nachman may? amar leh: la shemia li, kelomar la sevira li. may ikka? mishshum peres veozniyya? letanhu bayyishshuv.
Amar rav yehuda: of hamesaret – kasher letohorat metzora, vezo hi senunit levana shennechleku bah rabbi eliezer vachachamim.
Amar ammemar: bechivvara keresa – kulle alma la peligi desharya, ki peligi – bedirukka keresa, rabbi eliezer asar verabbanan sharu, vehilcheta kerabbi eliezer.
Mar zutera matne hachi: bedirukka keresa, kulle alma la peligi daasir. ki peligi bidchivvara keresa, rabbi eliezer asar verabbanan sharu, vehilcheta kerabbanan desharu.
Bishlama leman deamar bechivvara keresa peligi – hayeynu dekatane "zo hi senunit levana", ella leman deamar bedirukka peligi, may "zo hi senunit levana"? leappoke devatte deukkamti.

Amar rachava, amar rabbi yehuda: tasil pasul mishshum torin, vechasher mishshum bene yona, datzifi vetorin shel rechava kesherin mishshum torin, ufesulin mishshum bene yona. metiv rav daniel bar rav kattina: kol haofot
b: Poslin beme chattat chutz min hayyona mippene shemmotzetzet, veim ita litne chutz miyyona vetasil! amar rabbi zera: ze motzetz umeki, veze motzetz veeno meki.

Amar rav yehuda: hane kufeshane tzutzeyayne kesherim legabbe mizbeach, vehen hen torin shel rechava. metivi: "ezov", velo ezov yon, velo ezov kocholi, velo ezov romi, velo midbari, velo kol ezov sheyyesh lo shem levavy.

Amar abbaye: kol shennishtanna shemo kodem mattan tora, vehikpida tora alav, yesh lo shem levavy – pasul. vehane lo nishtanna sheman kodem mattan tora. rava amar: hane kufeshane tzutzeyayne, beatrayyhu setama kare lehu.

Amar rav yehuda: hane keraze deve chilfe sharu, udeve kerave asiri. amar ravina: umalkinan alayyhu mishshum sheretz haof. veamar rav yehuda: tzerada – shere, barda – asir, vesimanaych "bar minneh", marda – sefeka.

Amar rav assi: shemona sefekot hen: chova, chuga, suga, veharenuga, tushelmi, umarda, kochilna, uvar nappacha. may sefekayyhu? ofot tehorim kurekvanan niklaf, utemein en kurekvanan niklaf, vehane kurekvanan niklaf besakkina.

Veha hahi bar avavza dahava be mar shemuel, dela hava ka mikkelef kurekvaneh, veotveh beshimsha, vechevan derafe ikkelef! hatam, ki rafe ikkelef bida. hacha, af al gav derafe, la mikkelef ella besakkina.

Amar abbaye: tarnegola deagma chad mishshemona sefekot hu, vehayeynu mardu. amar rav pappa: tarnegola deagma asira, tarnegolta deagma sharya, vesimanaych – "ammoni velo ammonit". derash marimar: tarnegolta deagma asira, chazyuha dedarsa veachla, vehayeynu geruta.
Amar rav: shabbur anaddarpatta – shere, peruz anaddarpatta – asir, vesimanaych – peruz rashshia. amar rav huna: buneya – shere, parva – asir, vesimanaych – parvaa amgusha.

Amar rav pappa: mardu zaged veachel – shere, saged veachel – asir, vesimanaych "lo tishtachave leel acher". amar shemuel: shatya chamra – asira, vesimanaych "shetuye yayin pesulin laavoda". veamar shemuel: mazga chamra – asira,

a: Bat mazga chamra – sharya, vesimanaych "yafe koach habben mikkoach haav".
Amar rav yehuda: shekitana, ariche shake vesummake – sharya, vesimanaych murezma. gutze vesummake – asiri, vesimanaych "nanus pasul". ariche shake virukke – asiri, vesimanaych "yerukkin pesulin".
Amar rav yehuda: "shalach", ze hashshole dagim min hayyam. "duchifat", shehodo kafut. tanya name hachi: duchifat, shehodo kafut, vezehu shehevi shamir levet hammikdash.
Rabbi yochanan, ki hava chaze shalach, amar: "mishpatecha tehom rabba". ki hava chaze nemala, amar: "tzidkatcha keharere el".

Amar ammemar: lakni uvatni – sharyayn, shaknay uvatnay – mekom shennahagu leechol ochlin, mekom shennahagu shello leechol en ochlin. attu beminhaga talya milleta? in, vela kashya: ha beatra dishchichi peres veozniyya, ha beatra dela shechichi peres veozniyya.
Amar abbaye: kue vekakoe asiri, kakoata sharya. bemareva malku illava, vekaru la tachvavta.

Tanu rabbanan: "tinshemet" bavat shebbaofot. atta omer bavat shebbaofot, o eno ella bavat shebbashsheratzim? amarta: tze ulemad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen, davar hallamed meinyano. bema hakkatuv medabber? beofot, af kan beofot.

Tanya name gabbe sheratzim kehay gavvna: "tinshemet" bavat shebbashsheratzim. atta omer bavat shebbashsheratzim, o eno ella bavat shebbaofot? amarta: tze ulemad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen, davar hallamed meinyano – bema hakkatuv medabber? bishratzim, af kan bishratzim.
Amar abbaye: bavat shebbaofot – kifof, bavat shebbashsheratzim – kurepday. amar rav yehuda: "kaat" – zo hakkuk, "racham" – zo sherakrak.

Amar rabbi yochanan: lamma nikra shemo racham? kevan shebba racham bau rachamim leolam. amar rav bivi bar abbaye: vehu deyatev ammidde veaved "sherakrak", ugemiri dei yatev aara vesharek – ata meshicha, shenneemar: "eshreka lahem vaakabbetzem".
Amar leh rav adda bar shimi lemar bar rav iday: veha hahu deyatev be cherava usherak, vaata galal afsekeh lemocheh! amar leh: hahu bayyayda hava.
Tanu rabbanan: "orev" – ze orev, "et kol orev" – lehavi orev haimki, "lemino" – lehavi orev have berashe yonim.

Amar mar: "orev" – ze orev. attu kamman kae? ella ema: "orev" – ze orev ukkama, vechen hu omer: "kevutztzotav taltallim shechorot kaorev". haimki – chivvavra, vechen hu omer: "umarehu amok min haor", kemare chamma haamukka min hatztzel.
Veorev habba berashe yonim, amar rav pappa: la tema deate beresh yone, ella dedame resheh lidyona.
Tanu rabbanan: "hannetz" – ze hannetz, "leminehu" – lehavi et bar chirya. may bar chirya? amar abbaye: shurinka.
Amar rav yehuda: "hachasida" – zo dayya levana. lamma nikra shemah chasida? sheosa chasidut im chavroteha. "haanafa" – zo dayya ragzanit. lamma nikra shemah anafa? shemmenaafet im chavroteha.

Amar rav chanan bar rav chisda amar rav chisda amar rav chanan bereh derava amar rav: esrim vearbaa ofot temein hen. amar leh rav chanan bar rav chisda lerav chisda: dehecha? i devayyikra – esrim havu, i demishne tora – esrim vechad havu, vechi tema daa dichtiva bevayyikra vela ketiva bemishne tora shidyay alayyhu – akkatti esrin uteren havu!
Amar leh: hachi amar avu deimmach mishshemeh derav: "leminah" "leminah" "lemino" "leminehu" – hare kan arba. i hachi esrin veshet havu? amar abbaye: daa veraa achat hi, dei salka datach tarte innun,
b: Mikkede mishne tora leosofe hu daata, may shena hacha dichtiv "daa" umay shena hacha dichtiv "raa" vela ketiv "daa"? ella shema minna min raa vedaa achat hi.

Veakkatti esrin vechamsha havu? amar abbaye: keshem sheraa vedaa achat hi, kach ayya vedayya achat hi. dei salka datach tarte innun, mikkede mishne tora leosofe hu daata, may shena hacha dichtiv "leminah" aayya, umay shena hatam dichtiv "leminah" addayya? ella shema minna: ayya vedayya achat hi.

Vechi meachar sheayya vedayya achat hi, lema leh lemichtav ayya vedayya? kidtanya, rabbi omer: ekra ani ayya, dayya lamma neemra? kede shello titten pitchon pe levaal din lachlok, shello tehe atta kore ayya vehu kore dayya, atta kore dayya vehu kore ayya, lechach katav bemishne tora: "veharaa veet haayya vehaddayya leminah".
Metivi: lamma nishnu? bivhema – mippene hashshesua, uvaofot – mippene haraa. may lav, middivhema dehatam leosofe, ofot name leosofe? la, hatam leosofe, hacha lefaroshe.

Ufeliga derabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu: raa zo ayya, velamma nikra shemah raa? sheroa beyoter, vechen hu omer: "nativ lo yedao ayit velo shezafattu en ayya", tana: omedet bevavel veroa nevela beeretz yisrael.

Midderaa hayeynu ayya, mikkelal dedaa lav hayeynu raa. mikkede mishne tora leosofe hu daata, may shena hacha dichtiv "daa", umay shena hatam dela ketiv "daa"? ella lav shema minna daa veraa veayya achat hi.

Umidderaa hayeynu ayya, mikkelal dedayya lav hayeynu ayya. may shena hatam dichtiv "leminehu" aayya, umay shena hacha dela ketiv "leminehu" aayya ella addayya? ella shema minna daa veraa dayya veayya achat hi.

Tanya, isi ben yehuda omer: mea ofot temein yesh bammizrach, vechullan min "ayya" hen. tane avimi bereh derabbi avahu: sheva meot mine dagim hen, ushemone meot mine chagavim, uleofot en mispar. ofot esrin vearbaa havu! ella: uleofot tehorim en mispar.

Tanya, rabbi omer: galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam shebbehema temea merubba min hattehorot, lefichach mana hakkatuv battehora. galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam sheofot tehorin merubbin al hattemein, lefichach mana hakkatuv battemein.
May ka mashma lan? kidrav huna amar rav, veamri la amar rav huna amar rav mishshum rabbi meir: leolam yishne adam letalmido derech ketzara.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: of tahor neechol bemasoret, neeman hatztzayyayd lomar: of ze tahor, masar li rabbi. amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shebbaki bahen uvishmotehen.

Bae rabbi zera: rabbo chacham, o rabbo tzayyayd? ta shema, deamar rabbi yochanan: vehu shebbaki bahen uvishmotehen. i amrat bishlama rabbo tzayyayd – shappir, ella i amrat rabbo chacham, bishlama shemayyhu gemir lehu, ella inhu mi yada lehu? ella lav shema minna: rabbo tzayyayd. shema minna.
Tanu rabbanan: lokchin betzim min haggoyim bechol makom, veen choshshin lo mishshum nevelot velo mishshum terefot.
Vedilma deof tame ninhu? amar avu dishmuel: beomer shel of peloni tahor. velema shel of tahor? i hachi, it leh leishtemote.
Velivdok besimanin! detanya: kesimane vetzim kach simane dagim. simane dagim salka datach? "senappir vekaskeset" amar rachamana! ella ema: kach simane

a: Ubbere dagim.

Vetanya gabbe vetzim: ellu hen simane vetzim – kol shekkoderet vaagulegolet, roshah echad kad veroshah echad chad – tehora, shene rasheha kaddin o shene rasheha chaddin – temein. chelbon mibbachutz vechelmon mibbifnim – tehora, chelmon mibbachutz vechelbon mibbefanim – temea, chelmon vechelbon meoravin ze baze – beyadua shehi betzat hashsheretz.
La tzericha, dachatuchot. velivdok bechelmon vechelbon? bitrufot bikara.
Uchehay gavvna mi zavninan minnayyhu? veha tanya: en mochrin betzat terefa legoy, ella im ken terufa bikara; lefichach en lokchin mehem betzim terufot bikara.
Ella amar rabbi zera: simanin lav deorayyta, dei la tema hachi, ha deamar rav assi: shemona sefekot hen – livdok bevetzim didhu! ella shema minna: simanin lav deorayyta.

Ella lemay hilcheta katane la? hachi kaamar: shene rasheha kaddin, o shene rasheha chaddin, o chelmon mibbachutz vechelbon mibbifnim – vadday temea. resheh chad chad, resheh chad kad, vechelbon mibbachutz vechelmon mibbifnim, veamar lach shel of peloni vetahor hu – semoch aleh. bistama – la tismoch aleh, deikka deorva dedame lidyona.
Amar mar: chelbon vechelmon meoravin ze baze – beyadua shehi betzat hashsheretz. lemay hilcheta? amar rav ukeva bar chama: lomar sheim rikkema venikkeva bechaadasha – metamme.
Matkef la ravina: vedilma denachash hi? ella amar rava: sheim rikkema veachla – loke aleha mishshum "sheretz hashshoretz al haaretz".
I hachi, may irya ditmea? afillu dithora name! detanya: "kol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz" –
b: Lerabbot efrochim shello niftechu enehem! midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.
Tanu rabbanan: giule betzim muttarot, betzim muzarot – nefesh yafa tochlem, nimtza aleha koret dam – zorek et haddam veochel et hashshear.

Amar rabbi yirmeya: vehu shennimtza al kesher shellah. tane dostay avu derabbi aftoriki: lo shanu ella shennimtza al chelbon shellah, aval nimtza al chelmon shellah – afillu betza asura. may tama? dishda tichla bechulla. amar leh rav geviha mibbe chetil lerav ashe: ippecha tane tanna kammeh deabbaye, veabbaye hu detartza nihaleh hachi.

Amar chizkiyya: minnayin levetzat temea shehi asura min hattora? shenneemar: "veet bat hayyaana", vechi bat yesh lah layyaana? ella ezo – zo betza temea. vedilma hayeynu shemayyhu? la salka datach, dichtiv: "bat ammi leachzar kayenim bammidbar".
Vela? veha ketiv: "eese misped kattannim veevel kivnot yaana"? keyaana zo shemmitabbelet al baneha. veha ketiv: "veshachnu sham benot yaana"? keyaana zo sheshshochenet im baneha.
Vehachtiv: "techabbedeni chayyat hassade tannim uvenot yaana", vei salka datach betza, betza bat memar shira hi? ella, ketiv "hayyaana", uchetiv "bat hayyaana".
Veshane hacha, defasek safra lishte tevot, umiddefasek lehu safra

a: Betarte tevot, shema minna tere shemot ninhu.

Ella meatta "et kedor laomer" defasek lehu safra bitre, hachi name ditre sheme ninhu? amri: hatam bishte tevot pasek lehu, bishne shitin la pasek lehu, aval hacha afillu bishne shitin name pasek lehu.

Aval amru chachamim: kol of. tanya, rabban gamliel omer: dores veochel – beyadua shehu tame, yesh lo etzba yetera vezefek vekurkevano niklaf – beyadua shehu tahor. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: motchin lo chut shel meshicha, im cholek et raglav, shetayim lechan ushetayim lechan – tame, shalosh lechan veachat lechan – tahor. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kol of hakkolet min haavir – tame.
Tzipparta name miklat kalta! amar abbaye: "kolet veochel" kaamri.
Acherim omrim: shachen im temeim – tame, im tehorim – tahor.
Keman? kerabbi eliezer, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: lo lechinnam halach zarzir etzel orev, ella mippene shehu mino. afillu tema rabbanan, shachen venidme kaamrinan.
Uvachagavim, kol sheyyesh lo kulei. may rubbo? amar rav yehuda amar rav: rov orko, veamri la: rov hekkefo. amar rav pappa: hilkach baenan rov orko, uvaenan rov hekkefo.

Tanu rabbanan: en lo achshav veatid legaddel leachar zeman, kegon hazzachal – muttar. rabbi elazar berabbi yose omer: "asher lo cheraayim" – af al pi sheen lo achshav veatid legaddel leachar zeman. may zachal? amar abbaye: askera.

Tanu rabbanan: "et elle mehem tochelu et haarbe vegomer". arbe – ze govay, salam – ze rashon, chargol – ze nippul, chagav – ze nadyan. ma talmud lomar "lemino" "leminehu" "leminehu" "leminehu" arba peamim? lehavi tzipporet keramim, veyochana yerushalmit, vehaartzuveya, veharazbanit.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: ellu kelale chelalot, veellu perate feratot. "arbe" – ze "govay", "lemino" lehavi
b: Tzipporet keramim.
En li ella habba veen lo gabbachat. habba veyesh lo gabbachat minnayin? talmud lomar "solam" – ze nippul, "leminehu" – lehavi et haushekaf.

Veen li ella habba veen lo gabbachat, habba veyesh lo gabbachat. habba veen lo zanav, habba veyesh lo zanav minnayin? talmud lomar "chargol" – ze rashon, "leminehu" – lehavi et hakkarsefet veet hashshachalanit.
Veen li ella habba veen lo gabbachat, habba veyesh lo gabbachat; habba veen lo zanav, habba veyesh lo zanav. habba veen rosho aroch, habba verosho aroch minnayin?

Amarta: hare atta dan binyan av mishsheloshtan, lo rei arbe kiri chargol, velo rei chargol kiri arbe, velo rei shenehem kiri solam, velo rei solam kiri shenehem. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – sheyyesh lo arba raglayim, vearba kenafayim, vekartzullayim, uchenafav chofin et rubbo; af kol sheyyesh lo arba raglayim, vearba kenafayim, vekartzullayim, uchenafav chofin et rubbo.
Vahalo hatztzartzur hazze yesh lo arba raglayim, vearba kenafayim, vekartzullayim, uchenafav chofin et rubbo, yachol yehe muttar? talmud lomar "chagav", sheshshemo chagav.
I shemo chagav, yachol en bo kol hassimanin hallalu? talmud lomar "leminehu" – ad sheyyehe bo kol hassimanin hallalu.
Parech rav achay: ma lehanach, shekken en roshan aroch? vechi tema: kevan deshavu bearba simanin mayytinan vela parchinan – i hachi, chargol name deshavu lehu, la lichtov vetete mearbe vesolam!
Ella, ikka lemifrach: ma lehanach shekken en lahen zanav. hachi name ikka lemifrach: ma lehanach shekken en roshan aroch?

Ella amar rav achay: solam yattira hu, la lichtov rachamana "solam", vetete mearbe umechargol, demay parchat? ma learbe deen lo gabbachat – hare chargol deyesh lo gabbachat, ma lechargol deyesh lo zanav – hare arbe deen lo zanav, solam dichtav rachamana lema li? im eno inyan legufo – tenehu inyan lerosho aroch.

a: Bemay kamippalgi tana deve rav vetana deve rabbi yishmael? berosho aroch kamippalgi.

Tana deve rav savar: "asher lo keraayim" – kalal, "arbe" "solam" "chargol" "chagav" "leminehu" – parat, kelal uferat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat, demineh – in, delav (dameyneyh) [minneh] – la, umerabbe dedame leh mishshene tzedadin.

Tana deve rabbi yishmael savar: "asher lo cheraayim" – kalal, "arbe" "solam" "chargol" "chagav" – parat, "leminehu" – chazar vechalal, kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella cheen happerat, umerabbe kol dedame leh bechad tzad.
Veha la dame kelala kamma lichlala batra? kelala kamma – "asher lo cheraayim" amar rachamana, deit leh echol, delet leh la techol. kelala batra – ad deshavu bearbaa simanin.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael bichlale uferate ki hay gavvna daen, udeamrinan name bealma dedaen tana deve rabbi yishmael bichlale uferate ki hay gavvna mehacha.
Amar mar: i shemo "chagav", yachol en bo kol hassimanin hallalu? talmud lomar "leminehu" – ad sheyyehu bo kol hassimanin hallalu. en bo kol hassimanin hallalu mehecha tete? "arbe" vechargol" ketiv!
I la ketiv "solam" – kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv "solam" – lerabboye rosho aroch, ema lirabbe name kol dehu – ka mashma lan.
May shena hatam deamrat: "solam" – ze "rashon", "chargol" – ze "nippul", umay shena hacha deamrat: "solam" – ze "nippul", "chargol" – ze "rashon"? mar ki atreh umar ki atreh.

Uvaddagim kol sheyyesh lo senappir vekaskeset. tanu rabbanan: en lo achshav veatid legaddel leachar zeman, kegon hassuletanit vehaafyan – hare ze muttar. yesh lo achshav veatid lehashshiran beshaa sheole min hammayim, kegon
b: Akunas vaafunas keseppatyas veekkespatyas vaatunas – hare ze muttar.
Tenan hatam: kol sheyyesh lo kaskeset yesh lo senappir, veyesh sheyyesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset. yesh lo kaskeset veyesh lo senappir – dag tahor, yesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset – dag tame.

Mikkede akkaskeset ka samchinan, lichtov rachamana kaskeset vela lichtov senappir! i ketav rachamana kaskeset vela ketav senappir, hava amena: may kaskeset? senappir, vaafillu dag tame. ketav rachamana senappir vekaskeset.
Vehasheta dichtav rachamana senappir vekaskeset, mimmay dekaskeset levusha hu, dichtiv "veshiryon kaskassim hu lavush", velichtov rachamana kaskeset vela lichtov senappir?
Amar rabbi avahu, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: "yagdil tora veyadir".

Tanu rabbanan: mimmashma shenneemar "echol et sheyyesh lo", shomea ani "al tochal et sheen lo", umimmashma shenneemar "al tochal et sheen lo", shomea ani "echol et sheyyesh lo". velamma shenaan? laavor alav baase velo taase.

"Tochlu mikkol asher bammayim", ma talmud lomar? sheyyachol hoil vehittir bimforash vehittir bistam, ma keshehittir bimforash lo hittir ella bechelim, af keshehittir bistam lo hittir ella bechelim. minnayin lerabbot borot shichin umearot, sheshshoche veshote mehen veeno nimna? talmud lomar "tochlu mikkol asher bammayim".
Hechan hittir bechelim? dichtiv: "et ze tochlu mikkol asher bammayim vegomer", bayyammim uvannechalim hu dechi it leh – echol, delet leh – la techol, ha bechelim – af al gav delet leh – echol.

Ema: bechelim – af al gav deit leh la techol? la salka datach, dichtiv: "vechol asher en lo senappir vekaskeset bayyammim uvannechalim mikkol sheretz hammayim" – bayyammim uvannechalim delet leh la techol, ha bechelim – af al gav delet leh echol.
Veema: "bammayim" – kalal, "bayyammim uvannechalim" – parat, kelal uferat – en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat; yammim unechalim – in, neitzin vacharitzin – lo.
"Bammayim" – chazar vechalal.
Hane tere kelale dismichi lahadade ninhu, amar ravina: kidamri bemareva, kol makom sheatta motze shene kelalot hassemuchin ze laze –

a: Hattel perat benehem vedunem bichlal uferat uchelal, "bammayim" – kalal, "bayyammim uvannechalim" – parat, "bammayim" – chazar vechalal.
Kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat, ma happerat meforash mayim novim, af kol mayim novim. may rabbi? charitzin uneitzin leissura, umay maet? borot shichin umearot lehettera.
Veema: ma happerat meforash – mayim gedelin al gabbe karka, af kol mayim gedelin al gabbe karka. umay rabbi? afillu borot shichin umearot leissura, umay maet? maet kelim!
Im ken, "tochlu" may ahani leh?

Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "bammayim" "bammayim" shete feamim, en ze kelal uferat, ella ribba umiet. "bammayim" – ribba, "bayyammim uvannechalim" – miet, "bammayim" – chazar veribba. ribba umiet veribba – ribba hakkol. may rabbi? charitzin uneitzin leissura, umay maet? borot shichin umearot lehettera.
Ema: may rabbi? borot shichin umearot leissura, umay maet? maet kelim. im ken, "tochlu" may ahani leh?

Veefoch ana, kidtane mattitya, detane mattitya bar yehuda: may raita lerabbot borot shichin umearot lehettera, ulehotzi charitzin uneitzin leissura? merabbe ani borot shichin umearot shehen atzurim kechelim, umotzi ani charitzin uneitzin sheen atzurin kechelim.
He satum vehe meforash? peligi ba rav acha veravina: chad amar: yesh lo – meforash, veen lo – satum, vechad amar: en lo – meforash, veyesh lo – satum.
May tama deman deamar yesh lo meforash? amar lach: minneh hu deka mishteru kelim.
May tama deman deamar en lo meforash? dehay hu dekamochach ahaych, dei mehaych hava amena: bechelim, af al gav deit leh – name la techul.
Amar rav huna: la lishpe inash shichra betzivyayta beureta, dilma paresh leel mitztzivyayta vahadar nafel lechasa, (vehave) [veka] ovar mishshum "sheretz hashshoretz al haaretz".
I hachi, bemana name, dilma paresh ledafna demana vahadar nafel lemana? hatam hayeynu reviteh.

Umena temra, detanya: minnayin lerabbot borot shichin umearot, sheshshoche veshote mehen veeno nimna? talmud lomar: "tochlu mikkol asher bammayim". velechush dilma paresh ledafna vahadar nafel? ella hayeynu reviteh. hacha name hayeynu reviteh.
Amar leh rav chisda lerav huna: tanya dimsayyay lach, "kol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz" – lerabbot yavchushin shessinnenan; tama desinnenan, ha la sinnenan – shere.
Amar shemuel: kishshut shehitlia
b: Beibbeha asura mishshum "hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz".

Lema mesayyay leh, detane chada: "al haaretz" – lehotzi et hazzizin shebbaadashim, veet hayyattushim shebbakkallisim, vetolaat shebbattemarim veshebbaggerogrot. vetanya iddach: "kol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz" – lerabbot tolaat shebbeikkare zetim veshebbeikkare gefanim.
May lav, idde veidde befera, veha beibbeh, veha shella beibbeh?
La, idi veidi beibbeh, vela kashya: ha befera, ha beilana gufe.
Dayka name, dekatane "tolaat shebbeikkare zetim veshebbeikkare gefanim", shema minna.
Bae rav yosef: perashah umeta, mahu? miktzatah, mahu? laavir haolam, mahu? teku.
Bae rav ashe: legag temara mahu? legag garinatah mahu? mittemara litmara mahu? teku.
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: kukeyane asiri, may tama? mealma atu.
Matkef la rav ashe: i mealma atu, lishtachchu derech bet harei.
Ikka deamri, amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: kukeyane sheru. may tama? minneh gavli. amar rav ashe: peshita, dei mealma ka atu – lishtachchu derech bet harei!
Vehilcheta: kukeyane asiri, may tama? menam nayem veayyli leh beuseyeh tolaim. darne devisra – asiri, dechavvre – sharyayn.
Amar la ravina leimmeh: avla li vaana echol, amar leh rav mesharsheya bereh derav acha leravina: may shena meha detanya "veet nivlatam teshakketzu" lerabbot et hadderanim shebbabbehema?

Amar leh: hachi hasheta? behema bishchita hu demishtarya, vehane middela ka mahneya lehu shechita – beissurayyhu kayyman, aval dagim baasifa bealma mishteru, vehane ki ka gavlan – behettera ka gavlan.

Tanu rabbanan: "holech al gachon" – ze nachash, "kol" – lerabbot hashshilshul veet haddome leshilshul, "al arba" – ze akrav, "kol holech" – lerabbot et hachippushit veet haddome lechippushit, "marbe raglayim" – ze nadal, "ad kol" – lerabbot et haddome veet haddome laddome.

Tanya, rabbi yose ben dormaskit omer: livyatan dag tahor hu, shenneemar: "gaava afike maginnim", "tachtav chaddude cheres"; "afike maginnim" – ellu kaskassim shebbo, "tachtav chaddude cheres" – ellu senappirin shepporeach bahen.
Hadaran alach ellu terefot.

a: Mishna behema hamekashsha leled, vehotzi haubbar et yado vehechziro – muttar baachila. hotzi et rosho, af al pi shehechziro – hare ze keyalud.
Chotech meubbar shebbemeeha – muttar baachila, min hattechol umin hakkelayot – asur baachila. ze hakkelal: davar sheggufah – asur, vesheenah gufah – muttar.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: veever atzmo asur.
May tama? deamar kera: "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu", kevan sheyyatza basar chutz limchitzato – neesar.
Tenan: behema hamekashsha leled, vehotzi haubbar et yado vehechziro – muttar baachila. may lav aever? la, aubbar.

I aubbar, may irya hechziro? afillu lo hechziro name! hu haddin af al gav delo hechziro. veayyeyde deka bae mitne sefa: hotzi et rosho af al pi shehechziro – hare ze keyalud, tena name resha hechziro.

Vesefa, may kamashma lan? dechevan deyatza rosho havya la leda? tenena: ezehu bechor lenachala veeno bechor lechohanim – habba achar nefalim, af al pi sheyyatza rosho chay, o ben tisha sheyyatza rosho met.
Tama derosho met, ha rosho chay – habba acharav bechor lenachala name la have.
Vechi tema, ashmeinan beadam, veka mashma lan bivhema.
Deadam mibbehema la yalef, deen perozdor livhema, uvehema meadam la yalfa, dachashiv partzuf panim dideh.
Ha name tenena: shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah – asura baachila, kesiman valad baishsha kach siman valad babbehema!
I amrat bishlama hechziro deresha davka, tena sefa attu resha.
Ella i amrat: la deresha davka, vela desefa davka, lema leh lemitneyay kelal?
La, leolam aubbar, vechidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach. hacha name, lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach.
Ta shema: behema hamekashsha leled, hotzi ubbar et yado vehechzirah, veachar kach shachat et immo – muttar baachila. shachat et immo veachar kach hechzirah – asur baachila.
Hotzi et yado vachatacho, veachar kach shachat et immo – shebbachutz tame veasur, veshebbifnim tahor umuttar.
Shachat et immo veachar kach chatacho –
b: Habbasar magga nevela, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: magga terefa shechuta.
Katane miha resha: hotzi ubbar et yado vehechzirah, veachar kach shachat et immo – muttar baachila; may lav aever? la, aubbar.
I aubbar, ema sefa: shachat et immo veachar kach hechziro – asur baachila; vei ubbar, ammay asur?
Kidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach, hacha name lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach.
Ini? veha ki ata avimi mibbe chozae, ata veayyti matnita bideh: parsa hechzir – echol, perasot hechzir – echol. may lav hechzir parsa – achul parsa?
Lo, hechezir parsa – echol ubbar. i ubbar, may irya hechzir? afillu lo hechezir name! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach.
Veha tere kerae ka nasev la! may lav chad leever, vechad limkom chatach? la, chad limkom chatach, vechad lekalut bime fara.
Veallibba derabbi shimon, deamar rabbi shimon: kalut ben para asur. hane mille hecha deyatza laavir haolam, aval bime immo – shere.
Ulla amar rabbi yochanan: veever atzmo muttar.

Amar leh rav yehuda leulla: veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu ever atzmo asur! amar leh: man yahev lan meafra derav ushemuel umalenan ayynin, ella hachi amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol hayu bichlal "basar bassade terefa lo tochelu",
Keshepparat lecha hakkatuv gabbe chattat sheyyatzta chutz limchitzatah vechazra – asur, chattat hu difrat rachamana bah, aval kol mille – kevan dahadur – shere.

Metivi: "basar bassade terefa lo tochelu", ma talmud lomar? lefi shemmatzinu bemaaser sheni uvikkurim, sheaf al pi sheyyatzu chutz limchitzatan vechazru – muttarin, yachol af ze ken? talmud lomar "terefa".
May talmuda? amar rabba: kitrefa, ma terefa – kevan shennitrefa shuv en lah hetter, af basar – kevan sheyyatza chutz limchitzato shuv en lo hetter! teyuveta deulla, teyuveta.
Amar mar: lefi shemmatzinu bemaaser sheni uvikkurim. hechan matzinu?
Dichtiv: "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar deganecha vegomer", bisharecha hu dela techul, aval yatzu chutz limchitzatan vechazru – muttarin.
Bemareva matnu hachi, rav amar: yesh leda leevarim, verabbi yochanan amar: en leda leevarim.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu lemesar miut ever shebbifnim.

Ibbaya lehu: ledivre haomer en leda leevarim, hotzi haubbar et yado vehechzirah, vechazar vehotzi et yado vehechzirah, ad shehishlimo lerubbo, mahu? mi amrinan ha nefak leh rubba, o dilma kevan dahadar hadar?

Im timtze lomar, kevan dahadar hadar, hotzi ubbar et yado vachatachah, vechazar vehotzi et yado vachatachah, ad shehishlimo lerubbo, mahu? mi amrinan ha nafek leh rubba, o dilma rubba bevat achat baenan?
Ta shema:

a: Ze hakkelal: davar sheggufah – asur, vesheenah gufah – muttar. sheen gufah leetoye may? lav leetoye kehay gavna?
La, leetoye kalut bime para, veallibba derabbi shimon, deaf al gav deamar rabbi shimon: kalut ben para asur – hane mille hecha deyatza laavir haolam, aval bime immo – shere.
Bae rav chananya: hotzi ubbar et yado baazara, mahu? miggo dehave mechitza legabbe kadashim – have name legabbe dehay, o dilma legabbe dehay lav mechitza hi, dimchitzat ubbar – immo hi?
Amar leh abbaye: vetibbee lach kadashim kallim birushalayim? kadashim kallim birushalayim may tama la ka mibbaya lach? dimchitzat ubbar immo hiv, hacha name mechitzat ubbar immo hiv.
Bae ilfa: hotzi ubbar et yado ben siman lesiman, mahu?
Mi mitztaref siman rishon lesiman sheni letahoreh mide nevela, o la? amar rava: kal vachomer, im hoil lo siman rishon lesiman sheni lehattiro baachila, lo yoil lo letahoreh mide nevela?
Bae rabbi yirmeya: mahu lachosh lezaro?
Hechi dame? illema daazal abbehema meallayyta, may irya hay deit beh issur yotze?
Afillu ben pekua dealma name, deamar rav mesharsheya: ledivre haomer choshshin lezera haav, ben pekua habba al behema meallayyta – havvalad en lo takkana.
La tzericha, daazal abben pekua dichvavteh. may? ever molid ever, vechatech leh ushere, o dilma mibbalbal zareh?
Hadar amar: peshita demibbalbal zareh, deim ken, some yivvaled some, vekittea yivvaled kittea!
Ella peshita demibbalbal zareh, vehachi kamibbaya lan: behema bealma, lav mikkoach chelev vadam kaatya, vesharya? hacha name la shena. o dilma: tere issure amrinan, telata la amrinan?
Uleman? i lerabbi meir – issur chelev vadam ikka, issur yotze lekka.
I lerabbi yehuda – issur yotze ikka, issur chelev vadam lekka!
Ditnan: gid hannashe noheg bashshelil, vechelbo asur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: en noheg bashshelil, vechelbo muttar.
Ella, kol mikkoach la amrinan dishre.
Vehachi kamibbaya lan: mahu ligmoa et chalavo? chalav dealma la keever min hachay dame, ushere, hay name la shena.
O dilma hatam, it leh takkanta leissureh bishchita, hacha let leh takkanta leissureh bishchita? teku.
Chotech meubbar vechulei. menalan? dichtiv: "vechol behema mafreset parsa vegomer", "behema … babbehema" – lerabbot et havvalad.
Ella meatta, yamiru bo!
Allema tenan: en memirin lo evarin beubbarin, velo ubbarin beevarin, velo evarin veubbarin bishlemin, velo shelemin bahen!
Ella, amar kera: "vechol behema", lerabbot et havvalad.

I hachi, afillu chotech min hattechol umin hakkelayot name, allema tenan: chotech min haubbar shebbemeeha – muttar baachila, min hattechol umin hakkelayot – asur baachila? amar kera: "otah" – shelema velo chasera.
Ella meatta, hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah demut yona tishtere? allema amar rabbi yochanan: hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah demut yona (asur) [asura] baachila?
b: Baena perasot, velekka.
Ella meatta, kalut bime para littesar? ha tana deve rabbi yishmael kerabbi shimon ben yochay: "parsa babbehema tochelu".

Rav shimi bar ashe amar: leolam kidkaamrat meikkara, udeka kashya lach "en memirin", ha manni? rabbi shimon hi, demakkesh temura lemaaser: ma maaser eno noheg baevarim veubbarim, af temura enah noheget baevarim veubbarim.
Umena temra, ditnan: amar rabbi yose: vahalo bemukedashim, haomer: "raglah shel zo ola" – kullah ola, af kesheyyomar: "regel shel zo tachat zo" – tehe kullah temura tachteha.

Leman ka mahdar leh? illema lerabbi meir verabbi yehuda, mi it lehu hay sevara? vehatanya: yachol haomer "raglah shel zo ola" tehe kullah ola? talmud lomar: "kol asher yitten mimmennu laAdonai yihye kodesh" – mimmennu kodesh, velo kullo kodesh.
Yachol tetze lechullin? talmud lomar: "yihye" – bahavayaytah tehe. ha ketzad? timmacher letzorche olot, vedameha chullin, chutz middeme ever shebbah – divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: minnayin laomer "raglah shel zo ola" – tehe kullah ola? talmud lomar: "yihye" – lerabbot et kullah.
Leman? i lerabbi meir verabbi yehuda – mi it lehu hay sevara? ella lav lerabbi shimon!
La, rabbi yose tama denafsheh kaamar.
Mishna hamevakkeret, hamekashsha leled – mechattech ever ever, umashlich lichlavim. yatza rubbo – hare ze yikkaver, venifteret min habbechora.
Gemara ittemar: yatza shelish umecharo legoy, vechazar veyatza shelish acher – rav huna amar: kadosh, rabba amar: eno kadosh.
Rav huna amar kadosh: kasavar lemafrea kadosh, vechevan dinfak leh rubbeh – iggallay milleta lemafrea demeikkara hava kadosh, umay dezabben – lo kelum zabben.
Rabba amar eno kadosh: kasavar mikkan ulehabba kadosh, umay dezabben – shappir zabben.
Veazdu letamayyhu, deittemar: yatza shelish derech dofen, ushene shelishe derech rechem – rav huna amar: eno kadosh, rabba amar: kadosh.
Rav huna amar: eno kadosh. rav huna letameh, deamar: lemafrea kadosh, verubba kamma leteh berechem. rabba amar: kadosh. rabba letameh, deamar: mikkan ulehabba kadosh, verubba derech rechem nafek.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan beha: beha kaamar rav huna mishshum dilkulla, aval behach dilchumera – ema mode leh lerabba.

a: Vei ittemar beha: beha kaamar rabba, aval beha – ema mode leh lerav huna, tzericha.
Tenan: hamevakkeret hamekashsha leled – mechattech ever ever umashlich lichlavim. may lav, mechattech umanniach? vei amrat lemafrea hu kadosh – yikkaver mibbee leh!
La, hacha bemay askinan? bimchattech umashlich.

Aval mechattech umanniach, may yikkaver? additna sefa: "yatza rubbo yikkaver veniftera min habbechora", liflog velitne bedideh: bamme devarim amurim – bimchattech umashlich ever ever, aval mechattech umanniach – yikkaver.
