Hachi name kaamar: bamme devarim amurim? bimchattech umashlich, aval mechattech umanniach – naasa kemi sheyyatza rubbo, veyikkaver.
Bae rava: halchu beevarin achar harov, o lo halchu beevarin achar harov?
Hechi dame: illema, kegon sheyyatza rov bemiut ever, veka mibbaya leh: hay miut devaray, batar rov deever shadenan leh, o batar rubba deubbar shadenan leh?
Peshita dela shavkinan rubba deubbar, veazlinan batar rov ever!
Ella, kegon sheyyatza chetzyo berov ever, veka mibbaya leh: hahu miut divgavvay, mahu lemishdeyeh batar rov ever?
Ta shama: yatza rubbo – hare ze yikkaver. may rubbo? illema rubbo mammash, ad hasheta la ashmeinan derubbo kechullo?
Ella lav, kegon sheyyatza chetzyo berov ever!
La, kegon sheyyatza rubbo bemiut ever, veka mashma lan dela shavkinan rubbo deubbar divhema veazlinan batar ever.
Bae rava: keracho besiv, mahu? betallito, mahu?
Beshilyato, mahu? beshilyato? orcheh hu! ella beshilya acheret, mahu?
Kerachattu vaachazattu vehotziattu, mahu? hechi dame? i dinfak derech resheh – petarteh! ella dinfak derech margelotav.
Belaathu chuleda vehotziattu, mahu? hotziattu? ha appekteh! ella, belaattu vehotziattu, vehichnisattu vehekiattu, veyatza meelav, mahu?
Hidbik shene rechamim, veyatza mizze venichnas laze, mahu? dideh patar, delav dideh la patar, o dilma delav dideh name patar? teku.
Bae rav acha: niftechu kotle bet harechem, mahu? avir rechem makdish, vehaikka, o dilma negiat rechem mekaddesha, veha lekka?

Bae mar bar rav ashe: nekeru kotle bet harechem, mahu? nekeru – letanhu! ella nekeru vetalu leh betzavvereh, may? bimkoman mekaddeshi, shello bimkoman lo mekaddeshi, o dilma shello bimkoman name mekaddeshi?

Bae minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: nigmemu kotle bet harechem, mahu? amar leh: ka nagat bevaya deibbaya lan, devae rabbi zera, veamri la bea minneh rabbi zera merabbi assi: omed merubbe al happarutz veyatza derech parutz, parutz merubbe al haomed veyatza derech omed, may?
Ad kan la ibbaya leh ella parutz merubbe al haomed, deikka omed beolam, aval nigmemu – la ka mibbaya leh.
b: Mishna behema shemmet ubbarah betoch meeha vehoshit haroe et yado venaga bo, ben bivhema temea ben bivhema tehora – tahor. rabbi yose haggelili omer: bitmea – tame, uvithora – tahor.
Gemara may tama detanna kamma? amar rav chisda: kal vachomer, im hoila immo lehattiro baachila, lo toil lo letahoreh mide nevela?

Ashkechan behema tehora, behema temea menalan? amar kera: "vechi yamut min habbehema" – zo behema temea, "asher hi lachem leochla" – zo behema tehora, ittakkash behema temea livhema tehora: ma behema tehora – ubbarah tahor, af behema temea – ubbarah tahor.
Verabbi yose haggelili, may tama? amar rabbi yitzchak: deamar kera "vechol holech al kappav bechol hachayya haholechet vegomer" – mehalleche kappayim bechayya timmeti lach.
Ella meatta, kalut bime fara litamme, dimhalleche chappayim bechayya hu? mehalleche chappayim bimhalleche arba, vehay mehalleche arba bimhalleche shemone hu.
Para bime gamal lo tetamme, dimhalleche shemone bimhalleche arba hu, "holech", "vechol holech" – lerabbot para bime gamal.
Kalut bime keluta litamme, dimhalleche arba bimhalleche arba hu! lehachi ahani kal vachomer derav chisda.
Matkef la rav achadvuy bar amme: chazir bime chazirta la litamme, dimhalleche shemone bimhalleche shemone hu!
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, mehacha: "nefesh ki tigga bechol tame o venivlat chayya temea o benivlat behema temea o benivlat sheretz tame".
Vechi nivlat behema temea metammea, uvithora lo metammea? ella eze ze? ze ubbar, shebbitmea tame, uvithora tahor.
Umeachar denafka leh midderav nachman bar yitzchak, derabbi yitzchak lema li? i lav derabbi yitzchak, hava amena: kulleh lechidrabbi hu daata, ka mashma lan.
Tanya, amar rabbi yonatan: namti lo leven azzay, lamadnu nivlat behema tehora shemmetammea, venivlat behema temea shemmetammea, nivlat chayya temea shemmetammea.
Nivlat chayya tehora lo lamadnu minnayin? nam li: "kol holech al kappav bechol hachayya haholechet".
Namti lo: vechi neemar "vechol chayya"? vahalo lo neemar ella "bechol hachayya", limhalleche kappayim bechayya hu daata. nam li: uma yishmael omer bedavar hazze?
Namti lo: "vechi yamut min habbehema" – zo behema temea, "asher hi lachem leochla" – zo behema tehora, lamadnu chayya bichlal behema, uvehema bichlal chayya.
Chayya tehora bichlal behema tehora, chayya temea bichlal behema temea,

a: Behema temea bichlal chayya temea, behema tehora bichlal chayya tehora, uvallashon hazze amar li: chaval al ben azzay shello shimmesh et rabbi yishmael.
Chayya bichlal behema menalan? dichtiv: "zot habbehema asher tochelu shor se chesavim vegomer ayyal utzevi veyachmur vegomer", ha ketzad? chayya bichlal behema.
Behema bichlal chayya menalan? dichtiv: "zot hachayya asher tochlu mikkol habbehema asher al haaretz kol mafreset parsa", ha ketzad? behema bichlal chayya.
Chayya tehora bichlal behema tehora – lesimanim.
Chayya temea bichlal behema temea – leharebaa.
Behema temea bichlal chayya temea – lechidrabbi.
Detanya, rabbi omer: ekra ani "chayya", behema lamma neemra?
Neemra kan "behema temea", veneemar lehallan "behema temea", ma lehallan tumeat kodesh – af kan tumeat kodesh.
Behema tehora bichlal chayya tehora, litzira, ditnan: hammappelet min behema chayya vaof, ben temein ben tehorin, im zachar – teshev lezachar.
Im nekeva – teshev linkeva.
Eno yadua – teshev lezachar velinkeva,
Divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: kol sheeno mitztzurat adam eno valad.
Ulerabbanan, hay kera lema li?
Kulleh lechidrabbi hu daata.
Mishna haishsha shemmet veladah betoch meeha, ufashta chayya et yadah venaga bo – hachayya temea tumeat shiva, vehaishsha tehora ad sheyyetze havvalad.
Gemara amar rabba: keshem shettumea belua enah metammea, kach tohora belua enah mittammea.
Tumea belua menalan? dichtiv: "vehaochel minnivlatah yechabbes begadav", mi la askinan daachal samuch lishkiat hachamma, vekaamar rachamana tahor.
Vedilma shane hatam, dela chazya leger.
Hanicha lerabbi yochanan, deamar: achat zo veachat zo, ad lechelev – shappir.
Ella levar peda, deamar: tumea chamura leger, vetumea kalla ad lechelev – mishshum dela chazya leger hu!
Nehi dela chazya befanav, shello befanav michazya chazya leh.
Ashkechan tumea belua, tohora belua menalan?
Kal vachomer: uma keli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil, sheeno matztzil al tumea shebbetocho milletamme, deamar mar: tumea retzutza bokaat veola ad larakia – matztzil al tohora shebbetocho milletamme,
b: Adam shemmatztzil al tumea shebbetocho milletamme – eno din shemmatztzil al tohora shebbetocho millittamme?
Ma lichli cheres, shekken en mittamme miggabbo, tomar baadam shemmittamme miggabbo?
Attu anan miggabbo kaamrinan? mittocho kaamrinan!
Adderabba, keli cheres chamur, shekken metamme meaviro.
Ashkechan balua dilmala, balua dilmatta menalan? kal vachomer: uma lemala, sheeno ose ikkul – matztzil, lematta sheose ikkul – eno din shemmatztzil?
Kelum ose ikkul lematta ella al yede mala? afillu hachi, ikkul dilmatta rav.
Ashkechan balua deadam, balua divhema menalan? kal vachomer: uma adam shemmittamme mechayyim matztzil bevalua, behema sheenah metammea mechayyim – eno din shettatztzil bevalua?
Ma leadam, shekken tzarich shehiyyay bevayit hamenugga, tomar bivhema, sheenah tzericha shehiyyay bevayit hamenugga?
Behema deenah tzericha shehiyyay bevayit hamenugga, lemay hilcheta? lechelim sheal gabbah. adam name la bae!

Ditnan: hannichnas levayit hamenugga vechelav al ketefav, vesandalav vetabbeotav beyadav – hu vehen temein miyyad. haya lavush kelav vesandalav beraglav vetabbeotav beetzbao – hu tame miyyad, vehen tehorin ad sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras, pat chittim velo pat seorim, mesev veochel beliftan.
Amar rava: tarvayyhu tenanhi, tumea belua tenena, tohora belua tenena!
Tumea belua – ditnan: bala tabbaat temea, tovel veochel bitrumato; hekiah – temea, vetimmeattu.
Tohora belua tenena, ditnan: bala tabbaat tehora, venichnas leohel hammet, vehizza veshana vetaval vehekiah – hare hi kema shehayta.
Ki kaamar rabba, kegon shebbala shete tabbaot, achat temea veachat tehora, dela metammeya la temea lithora.

a: Veha ubbar vechayya, dechishte tabbaot damu, veka metamme la ubbar lechayya?
Amar rabba: shane ubbar, hoil vesofo latzet. amar rava: ubbar sofo latzet, tabbaat en sofah latzet? ella amar rava: pumebditae yadi tama deha milleta, umannu? rav yosef.

Deamar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tumea zo enah middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim. may enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim? dela tema allibba derabbi akiva deamar: "ubbar bime ishsha tame", ella afillu lerabbi yishmael deamar: "ubbar bime ishsha tahor", gezaru ba tumea midderabbanan.
May tama? amar rav hoshaya: gezera shemma yotzi valad rosho chutz lapperozdor.
I hachi, ishsha name? ishsha margeshet beatzmah. vetema la lechayya! terida.
May rabbi yishmael, umay rabbi akiva? detanya: "vechol asher yigga al pene hassade" – lehotzi ubbar bime ishsha, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: lerabbot golel vedofek.

Verabbi yishmael, golel vedofek – hilcheta gemiri la. verabbi akiva, ubbar bime ishsha tame middeorayyta – mena leh? amar rabbi oshaya, amar kera: "hannogea bemet benefesh", ezehu met shebbenefesh shel adam? heve omer ze ubbar shebbime ishsha.
Verabbi yishmael, hay mibbee leh lirviit dam habbaa min hammet, shemmetammea, shenneemar: "hannogea bemet benefesh haadam", ezehu nefesh shel adam shemmetamme? heve omer zo reviit dam.
Verabbi akiva letameh, deamar: af reviit dam habbaa mishshene metim metamme beohel, detanya: rabbi akiva omer: minnayin lirviit dam habbaa mishshene metim shemmetammea beohel?
Shenneemar: "veal kol nafshot met lo yavo", shete nefashot veshiur echad.
Mishna behema hamekashsha leled, vehotzi ubbar et yado, vachatachah, veachar kach shachat et immo – habbasar tahor. shachat et immo veachar kach chatachah – habbasar magga nevela, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: magga terefa shechuta,
b: Ma matzinu bitrefa sheshshechitatah metahartah, af shechitat behema tetaher et haever.
Amar lahem rabbi meir: lo, im tihara shechitat terefa otah, davar sheggufah, tetaher et haever davar sheeno gufah?
Minnayin litrefa sheshshechitatah metahartah? behema temea asura baachila, af terefa asura baachila, ma behema temea – en shechitatah metahartah, af terefa – lo tetaharenna shechita!
Lo, im amarta bivhema temea shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher, tomar bitrefa shehayta lah sheat hakkosher?
Tol lecha ma sheheveta, hare shennolda terefa min habbeten, minnayin?
Lo, im amarta bivhema temea shekken en beminah shechita, tomar bitrefa sheyyesh beminah shechita?
Ben shemone chay, en shechitato metaharto, lefi sheen bemino shechita.
Gemara ammay? tumeat bet hassetarim hi, vetumeat bet hassetarim la metammeya! lema rabbi meir letameh?
Ditnan: shelosha al shelosha shennechlak – tahor min hammidras,
Aval tame magga midras, divre rabbi meir.
Vetanya, amar rabbi yose: vechi beeze midras naga ze? ella sheim naga bo zav, sheyyehe tame magga zav.
Lav ittemar ala, amar ulla: lo shanu ella shelosha al shelosha shennechlak.
Aval shalosh al shalosh habbaot mibbeged gadol – bishat perishatan meavihen, mekabbelot tumea meavihen. ha name bishat perishatan meever, mekabbel tumea meever.
Ravina amar: beged – lav lachaticha kae, ubbar – lachaticha kae, vechol haomed lachtoch
